RestrictStartDate="2006-12-01"><Title>The Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1997</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/schedule/6/paragraph/28" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/schedule/6/paragraph/28" id="schedule-6-paragraph-28">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-12b4f3"/>28</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/schedule/6/paragraph/28/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/schedule/6/paragraph/28/1" id="schedule-6-paragraph-28-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00051"/> are amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/schedule/6/paragraph/28/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/schedule/6/paragraph/28/2" id="schedule-6-paragraph-28-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedule 2 (dangerous occurrences)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/schedule/6/paragraph/28/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/schedule/6/paragraph/28/2/a" id="schedule-6-paragraph-28-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part I (general)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/425/schedule/6/paragraph/28/2/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/425/schedule/6/paragraph/28/2/a/i" id="schedule-6-paragraph-28-2-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for paragraph 6(1)(a), substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any unintentional fire, explosion or ignition at a site—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>where explosives are manufactured by a person who holds a licence, or who does not hold a licence but is required to, in respect of that manufacture under the Manufacture and Storage of Explosives Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2006; or</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>where explosives are stored by a person who holds a licence or is registered, or who is not licensed but is required to be in the absence of any registration, in respect of that storage under those Regulations;</Text>
<P5>
<Pnumber>aa</Pnumber>
<P5para>
<Text>the unintentional explosion or ignition of explosives at a place other than a site described in sub-paragraph (1)(a), not being one—</Text>
</P5para>

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Work at Height Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2005<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> shall be amended in accordance with the following paragraphs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 3 (Application)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2/a" id="regulation-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (4)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2/a/i" id="regulation-2-2-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (b), insert “or”; and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2/a/ii" id="regulation-2-2-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>omit sub-paragraph (d) and the word “or” preceding it; and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/2/b" id="regulation-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (6), omit sub-paragraphs (a) and (b).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2007/135/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 14 (Duties of persons at work) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Special provision in relation to caving and climbing</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">14A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<P2para><Text>Paragraph (2) applies in relation to the application of these Regulations to work concerning the provision of instruction or leadership to one or more persons in connection with their engagement in caving or climbing by way of sport, recreation, team building or similar activities.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Where this paragraph applies, an employer, self-employed person or other person shall be taken to have complied with the caving and climbing requirements, if, by alternative means to any requirement of those requirements, he maintains in relation to a person at such work as is referred to in paragraph (1) a level of safety equivalent to that required by those requirements.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>For the purposes of paragraph (2), in determining whether an equivalent level of safety is maintained, regard shall be had to—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>

law.title: Carriage of Dangerous Goods and Use of Transportable Pressure Equipment Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
Amendment of Regulations 2 The Carriage of Dangerous Goods and Use of Transportable Pressure Equipment Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2010 are amended in accordance with regulations 3 to 10. Interpretation – General 3 1 In regulation 2, the Table in paragraph (5) is amended as follows. 2 For the row containing the expression and meaning of “conformity mark”, substitute—
“conformity mark”The mark referred to in article 14 of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive, the form of the mark being set out in article 15 of that Directive.
3 Before the row in which the expression “conformity mark” is given a meaning, insert—
“conformity assessment”The assessment and the procedure for assessment of conformity set out in the Directives.
4 After the row in which the expression “the Dangerous Goods Directive” is given a meaning, insert—
“the Directives”The Dangerous Goods Directive and the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive.
5 After the row in which the expression “national carriage” is given a meaning, insert—
“relevant member State”A member State of the EU on whose market the equipment in question has been made available.
6 After the row in which the expression “the security provisions” is given a meaning, insert—
“TPED competent authority”The GB competent authority or the competent national authority in respect of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive in Northern Ireland or another member State of the EU.
7 For the row containing the expression and meaning of “the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive” substitute—
“the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive”Directive 2010/35/EU of the European Parliament and the Council of 16 June 2010 on transportable pressure equipment and repealing Council Directives 76/767/EEC, 84/525/EEC, 84/526/EEC, 84/527/EEC and 1999/36/EC.
Interpretation of <Acronym Expansion="Accord European Relatif au Transports International des Merchandises Dangereuses par Route" xml:lang="fr">ADR</Acronym>, <Acronym Expansion="Regulations Concerning the International Carriage of Dangerous Goods by Rail">RID</Acronym> and ADN 4 1 Regulation 3 is amended as follows. 2 In paragraphs (b) and (c), for “Communities” substitute “EU”. 3 Omit paragraphs (f), (g), and (h). 4 In paragraph (k), at the end, omit “and”. 5 In paragraph (l), at the end, for “.” substitute— ; m Sub-sections 2.2.1.1.2, 2.2.1.1.3 and 2.2.1.1.4 of ADR apply as if the words “by the competent authority of a Contracting Party” were included after the word “assigned”; and n Sub-sections 2.2.1.1.2, 2.2.1.1.3 and 2.2.1.1.4 of RID apply as if the words “by the competent authority of a Member State of COTIF” were included after the word “assigned”. . Obligations relating to the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive 5 1 For regulation 15, substitute— Scope of Obligations 15 1 Regulations 15A to 15F apply to transportable pressure equipment within the scope of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive by virtue of article 1(2)(a) of that Directive. 2 For the avoidance of doubt, any reference in those regulations to a manufacturer, importer, distributor, owner or operator as “it” is not to be construed as excluding a natural person. . 2 After regulation 15, insert— General Obligations 15A 1 A manufacturer, importer, distributor, owner or operator may only place or make available on the market, put into service or use equipment if it ensures that the equipment meets the requirements of the Dangerous Goods Directive. 2 On receipt of a request from the Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland, a manufacturer, importer, distributor, owner or operator must identify to the Executive any manufacturer, importer, distributor or owner who has supplied it with, or to whom it has supplied, equipment over at least the previous 10 years. 3 A request made pursuant to paragraph (2) must— a be in writing; and b contain a date by which a response is to be provided with that date being reasonable in all the circumstances. 4 Paragraph (5) applies where a manufacturer, importer, distributor or owner provides to an operator information about equipment it has placed or made available on the market, or put into service. 5 The information must comply with the Directives. 6 This regulation does not apply to an owner who is a private individual using or intending to use equipment in the circumstances set out in article 8(4) of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive. Obligations of Manufacturers 15B 1 A manufacturer must— a ensure a conformity assessment is carried out by a notified body; b mark equipment in accordance with articles 14 and 15 of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive; and c keep the technical documentation specified in the Dangerous Goods Directive for the period specified in that Directive. 2 Where a manufacturer knows or has reason to believe that equipment it has placed on the market does not comply with the Directives, that manufacturer must— a take immediate corrective measures to ensure that the equipment complies with the Directives, b withdraw the equipment from the market, or c issue a recall of the equipment. 3 Where a manufacturer considers that equipment it has placed on the market presents a risk, that manufacturer must immediately inform the TPED competent authority in any relevant member State of the risk, including providing details of any non-compliance with the Directives and any action taken in accordance with paragraph (2). 4 A manufacturer must record each instance of non-compliance with the Directives and any corrective measure taken and must retain that record for at least 20 years from the date that the non-compliance is discovered. 5 On receipt of a reasoned request from a TPED competent authority, a manufacturer must— a provide to that authority, in a language that it easily understands, all information and documents necessary to show that the equipment meets the requirements of the Directives; and b cooperate with that authority in any action it takes to eliminate risks posed by that equipment. 6 This regulation applies to an importer or a distributor as if that person were a manufacturer where the importer or distributor— a places equipment on the market under the importer or distributor’s own name or trademark; or b modifies equipment already placed on the market in such a way that compliance with the Directives may be affected. Obligations of Importers 15C 1 An importer must ensure that— a the manufacturer has complied with conformity assessment and drawn up the technical documentation in accordance with the Dangerous Goods Directive; b equipment has been marked in accordance with articles 14 and 15 of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive; c the certificate of conformity for the equipment either contains the name and address of the importer or has this information attached to it; d the conditions in which equipment under the responsibility of the importer is stored and transported do not jeopardise the equipment’s compliance with the Dangerous Goods Directive; and e the technical documentation specified in the Dangerous Goods Directive is kept for the period set out in that Directive. 2 Where an importer knows or has reason to believe that equipment it has placed on the market does not comply with the Directives, that importer must— a take immediate corrective measures to ensure that the equipment complies with the Directives; b withdraw the equipment from the market; or c issue a recall of the equipment. 3 Where an importer considers that equipment presents a risk before it has been placed on the market, that importer must inform the manufacturer and the Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland of the risk. 4 Where an importer considers that equipment it has placed on the market presents a risk, that importer must immediately inform the manufacturer and the TPED competent authority in any relevant member State of the risk, including details of any non-compliance with the Directives and any action taken in accordance with paragraph (2). 5 An importer must record each instance of non-compliance with the Directives and any corrective measure taken and must retain that record for at least 20 years from the date that the non-compliance is discovered. 6 On receipt of a reasoned request from a TPED competent authority, an importer must— a provide to that authority, in a language that it easily understands, all information and documents necessary to show that the equipment meets the requirements of the Directives; and b cooperate with that authority in any action taken to eliminate risks posed by that equipment. Obligations of Distributors 15D 1 A distributor must ensure that— a the equipment has been marked in accordance with articles 14 and 15 of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive; b the certificate of conformity for the equipment contains or has attached to it the name and address of the importer where relevant; and c the conditions in which equipment under the responsibility of the distributor is stored and transported do not jeopardise the equipment’s compliance with the Directives. 2 Where a distributor knows or has reason to believe that equipment it made available on the market does not comply with the Directives, that distributor must— a take immediate corrective measures to ensure that the equipment complies with the Directives; b withdraw the equipment from the market; or c issue a recall of the equipment. 3 Where a distributor considers that equipment presents a risk before it has been made available on the market, that distributor must inform— a the manufacturer or the importer; and b the Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland, of the risk. 4 Where a distributor considers that equipment it has made available on the market presents a risk, that distributor must immediately inform— a the manufacturer or the importer; and b the TPED competent authority in any relevant member State, of the risk, including details of any non-compliance with the Directives and any action taken in accordance with paragraph (2). 5 A distributor must record each instance of non-compliance with the Directives and any corrective measures taken and must retain that record for at least 20 years from the date that the non-compliance is discovered. 6 On receipt of a reasoned request from a TPED competent authority, a distributor must— a provide to that authority, in a language that it easily understands, all information and documents necessary to show that the equipment meets the requirements of the Directives; and b cooperate with that authority in any action taken to eliminate risks posed by that equipment. Obligations of Owners 15E 1 An owner must ensure that equipment for which it is responsible is stored and transported in conditions that do not jeopardise the compliance of that equipment with the Dangerous Goods Directive. 2 Where an owner considers that the owner’s equipment presents a risk it must inform— a the manufacturer, importer or distributor; and b the Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland, of the risk. 3 An owner must record each instance of non-compliance with the Directives and any corrective measure taken and must retain that record for at least 20 years from the date that the non-compliance is discovered. 4 This regulation does not apply to private individuals using or intending to use equipment in the circumstances set out in article 8(4) of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive. Obligations of Operators 15F Where an operator considers that equipment presents a risk, that operator must inform the owner and the Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland of the risk. . Authorised Representatives 6 For regulation 16, substitute— Authorised Representatives 16 1 Subject to paragraph (3), a manufacturer may appoint in writing a person (“an authorised representative”) to carry out some or all of the duites imposed on the manufacturer by regulations 15A and 15B. 2 An appointment made in accordance with paragraph (1) must include at least the following duties— a keeping technical documentation; b providing to a TPED competent authority, in response to a reasoned request and in a language that it easily understands, the information and documents necessary to show the equipment meets the requirements of the Directives; and c cooperating with a TPED competent authority in any action it takes to eliminate risks posed by the equipment. 3 An authorised representative must not be appointed to carry out duties imposed by regulation 15A(2), 15B(1)(a) or 15B(1)(b). 4 The name and address of an authorised representative must be included on the certificate of conformity. 5 An authorised representative must only provide information to an operator that complies with the requirements of the Directives. . Reassessment of conformity 7 1 Regulation 17 is amended as follows. 2 In paragraph (1), for “(b)” substitute “(c)”. 3 In paragraph (3)(a)— a after “reassessed by a”, insert “type A”; and b for “Part II of Annex IV” substitute “Annex III”. 4 For paragraph (3)(b), substitute— b inspected by a notified body notified for periodic inspection of that equipment and marked in accordance with the requirements of articles 14 and 15 of that Directive. . 5 For paragraph (4), substitute— 4 But if a pressure receptacle has been manufactured in series to a design type for which a type A notified body notified for reassessment of conformity has issued a certificate of type reassessment, the reassessment of conformity may be undertaken by a notified body notified for periodic inspection of that pressure receptacle. 6 After paragraph (4), insert— 5 In this regulation— a “certificate of type reassessment” means a certificate issued in accordance with paragraph 7 of Annex III to the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive; and b “type A notified body” means a notified body conforming to standard EN ISO/IEC 17020 type A as revised or reissued from time to time. . Periodic inspection and repeated use 8 1 Regulation 18 is amended as follows. 2 In paragraph (1), for “(c)” substitute “(b)”. 3 In paragraph (2)— a for “article 10(1) or (2)” substitute “articles 14 and 15”; b omit “or the marking for gas cylinders referred to in the second indent of article 1(2)(c) of that Directive”; and c for “article 6(1) of the Directive” substitute “the Dangerous Goods Directive”. 4 Omit paragraph (3). 5 In paragraph (4), for “article 10” substitute “articles 14 and 15”. Appointments by the Northern Ireland competent authority 9 1 Regulation 25 is amended as follows. 2 In paragraph (4), for “Annexes I and II to the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive” substitute “the Dangerous Goods Directive and the requirements set out in Articles 20 and 26 of the Transportable Pressure Equipment Directive.”. 3 Omit paragraph (5). Schedule 2 – Radiological Emergencies 10 1 Schedule 2 is amended as follows. 2 In paragraph 4— a in sub-paragraph (1), after “consignor”, insert “and the carrier”; and b in sub-paragraph (3), after “consignor”, insert “and the carrier”.

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2014/280/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2014/280" NumberOfProvisions="6" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2014/280/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2014/280/body" NumberOfProvisions="3" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the 2012 Regulations</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2014/280/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2014/280/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2014/280/regulation/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2014/280/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The 2012 Regulations shall be amended in accordance with paragraphs (2) and (3).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2014/280/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2014/280/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 12, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Fees for notifications under the Borehole Sites and Operations Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1995</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">12A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Subject to paragraph (3), a fee is payable to the Executive by the person referred to in column 2 of Schedule 9 for the performance by the Executive of such functions conferred on it as are specified in column 1 of that Schedule.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Any fee referred to in paragraph (1) is—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>not to exceed the sum of the costs reasonably incurred by the Executive for the performance of the function; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>payable within 30 days from the date of the invoice that the Executive has sent or given to the person who shall pay that fee, and such invoices shall include a statement of the work done and the costs incurred, including the period to which the statement relates.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>No fee is payable under paragraph (1) for the performance by the Executive of the functions specified in column 1 of Schedule 9 to the extent that, in respect of any such function, a fee is payable or has been paid pursuant to the Control of Major Accident Hazard Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>For the purposes of this regulation and Schedule 9, “the <Abbreviation Expansion="Borehole Sites and Operations Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1995 (S.R. 1995/491)">1995 Regulations</Abbreviation>” means the Borehole Sites and Operations Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1995<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>, and “borehole site” and “operator” have the same meaning as in those Regulations.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2014/280/regulation/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2014/280/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After Schedule 8 insert Schedule 9 as set out in the Schedule to these Regulations.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223" NumberOfProvisions="15" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223/body" NumberOfProvisions="15" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Consequential amendments to the Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1993</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1993<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> shall be amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For regulation 3(1)(a), substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a workplace which is or is in or on a ship, save that regulations 8(1) and (3) and 12(1) and (3) apply to such a workplace where the work involves any of the relevant operations in—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>a shipyard, whether or not the shipyard forms part of a harbour or wet dock; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>dock premises, not being work done —</Text><P5>
<Pnumber>aa</Pnumber>
<P5para><Text>by the master or crew of a ship;</Text></P5para>
</P5>
<P5>
<Pnumber>bb</Pnumber>
<P5para><Text>on board a ship during a trial run;</Text></P5para>
</P5>
<P5>
<Pnumber>cc</Pnumber>
<P5para><Text>for the purpose of raising or removing a ship which is sunk or stranded; or</Text></P5para>
</P5>
<P5>
<Pnumber>dd</Pnumber>
<P5para><Text>on a ship which is not under command, for the purpose of bringing it under command;</Text></P5para>
</P5>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4/3" id="regulation-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 3(1)(c), substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a workplace located below ground at a mine.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4/4" id="regulation-4-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Omit regulation 3(1)(d).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4/5" id="regulation-4-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 3(4), add—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>As respects any workplace which is located at a quarry or above ground at a mine, regulation 12 shall only apply to a floor or traffic route which is located inside a building.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223/regulation/4/6" id="regulation-4-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 3(5), add—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>For the purposes of this regulation—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>“dock premises” means any dock, wharf, quay, jetty or other place at which ships load or unload goods or embark or disembark passengers, together with neighbouring land or water which is used or occupied, or intended to be used or occupied, for those or incidental activities, and any part of a ship when used for those or incidental activities;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>“relevant operations” means, in relation to a ship, its repairing, refitting, painting and finishing, the scaling, scurfing or cleaning of its boilers (including combustion chambers or smoke boxes) and the cleaning of its bilges or oil-fuel tanks or any of its tanks last used for carrying oil;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>“ship” includes all vessels and hovercraft which operate on water or land and water;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>“shipyard” means any yard or dry dock (including the precincts thereof) in which ships or vessels are constructed, reconstructed, repaired, refitted or finished; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>“vessel” means any description of craft used for the transport of goods or passengers or the storage of goods or the accommodation of passengers on water, whether used in navigation or not.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Work at Height Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223" NumberOfProvisions="15" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223/body" NumberOfProvisions="15" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Consequential Amendments to the Work at Height Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2005</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/regulation/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223/regulation/5/1" id="regulation-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Work at Height Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2005<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> shall be amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/regulation/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223/regulation/5/2" id="regulation-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 8, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Dock Operations</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">8A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In relation to work at height where people are engaged in dock operations, every employer shall ensure that Schedule 10 is complied with.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/223/regulation/5/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/223/regulation/5/3" id="regulation-5-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After Schedule 9, add—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="schedule" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" NumberFormat="default">
<Schedule NumberFormat="default">
<Number>SCHEDULE<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>10</Number>
<TitleBlock>
<Title>REQUIREMENTS FOR WORK IN DOCKS</Title>
</TitleBlock>
<Reference>Regulation 8A</Reference>
<ScheduleBody>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In relation to work at height where people are engaged in dock operations, there shall be secure and adequate guardrails at the following places—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>every break, dangerous corner and other dangerous part or edge of a dock, wharf, quay or jetty; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>every open side of a gangway, footway over a bridge, caisson or dock gate,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>except in so far as the provision of such guardrails is impracticable because of the nature of the work carried out there and the work is in progress.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In this Schedule—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“dock gate” means any lock gate or other gate which can close off the entrance to the dock or part of the dock from the sea or other waterway but does not include any gate on land which controls access by vehicles or pedestrians;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“dock operations” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>the loading or unloading of goods on or from a ship at dock premises;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>the embarking or disembarking of passengers on or from a ship at dock premises;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>any activity incidental to the activities in sub-paragraph (a) or (b) which takes place on dock premises, including any of the following—</Text><OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="roman">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>the fuelling and provisioning of a ship;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>the mooring of a ship;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>the storing, sorting, inspecting, checking, weighing or handling of goods;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>the movement of goods, passengers or vehicles;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>the use of welfare amenities in relation to the activities in sub-paragraph (a), (b) or (c)(i) to (iv);</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>attending dock premises for the purposes of the activities in sub-paragraph (a), (b) or (c)(i) to (v); or</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>the embarking or disembarking on or from a ship of its crew at dock premises,</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
<Text>but does not include—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the loading or unloading of goods or embarking or disembarking of persons on or from a pleasure craft or any activity incidental to those activities; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>beach landing operations wholly carried out by serving members of Her Majesty’s Forces or visiting forces within the meaning of the provisions of Part 1 of the Visiting Forces Act 1952<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> or a combination of both;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“dock premises” means any dock, wharf, quay, jetty or other place at which ships load or unload goods or embark or disembark passengers, together with neighbouring land or water which is used or occupied, or intended to be used or occupied, for those or incidental activities, and any part of a ship when used for those or incidental activities;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“freight container” means a container as defined in regulation 2 of the Freight Containers (Safety Convention) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1992<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“goods” includes—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>animals;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>pallets and freight containers;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>waste;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>solid ballast;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>vehicles which are being transported as cargo;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“pleasure craft” means any description of vessel when used solely for sport or recreation, other than for carrying fare paying passengers;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“ship” includes all vessels and hovercraft which operate on water or land and water;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“vehicle” includes all lift trucks, locomotives and rolling stock, and trailers and semi-trailers and other mechanical plant which moves on wheels, tracks, skids or any combination thereof;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“vessel” means any description of craft used for the transport of goods or passengers or the storage of goods or the accommodation of passengers on water, whether used in navigation or not;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“welfare amenities” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>sanitary conveniences;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>baths and shower baths;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>washing facilities;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>a supply of wholesome drinking water;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>a supply of protective clothing, that is to say, clothing suitable for the protection of the wearer in refrigerated spaces or against dirt from handling dirty goods or against inclement weather;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>accommodation and facilities for changing into clothing worn during working hours and for storing and drying clothing;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>canteens, or accommodation and facilities (including facilities for heating food and boiling water) for workers employed at dock premises to eat meals provided by themselves;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>shelters for use during inclement weather.</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1>
</ScheduleBody>
</Schedule>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Health and Safety (Safety Signs and Signals) Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265" NumberOfProvisions="25" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/body" NumberOfProvisions="19"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Health and Safety (Safety Signs and Signals) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1996</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Health and Safety (Safety Signs and Signals) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1996<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/> are amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1), after the definition of “acoustic signal” insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Regulation EC 1272/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 December 2008 on classification, labelling and packaging of substances and mixtures, amending and repealing Directives 67/548/EEC and 1999/45/EC, and amending Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006">CLP Regulation</Abbreviation>” means Regulation <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/regulation/2008/1272" id="c00005" Class="EuropeanCommission" Year="2008" Number="1272">(EC) No 1272/2008</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 December 2008 on classification, labelling and packaging of substances and mixtures, amending and repealing Directives <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1967/0548" id="c00006" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1967" Number="548">67/548/<Acronym Expansion="European Economic Community">EEC</Acronym></Citation> and <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1999/0045" id="c00007" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1999" Number="45">1999/45/<Acronym Expansion="European Community">EC</Acronym></Citation> and amending Regulation <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/regulation/2006/1907" id="c00008" Class="EuropeanCommission" Year="2006" Number="1907">(EC) No. 1907/2006</Citation>, of which Articles 6(5), 11(3), 12, 14, 18(3)(b), 23, 25 to 29, 35(2) second and third sub-paragraphs and Annexes I to <Acronym Expansion="7">VII</Acronym> are to be read as amended from time to time;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/3" id="regulation-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 3(a)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/3/a" id="regulation-4-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for “dangerous” substitute “hazardous”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/3/b" id="regulation-4-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for “preparation” substitute “mixture”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4" id="regulation-4-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedule 1—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4/a" id="regulation-4-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part I, for paragraph 12 substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" Format="double"><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Areas, rooms or enclosures used for the storage of significant quantities of hazardous substances or mixtures shall be indicated by a suitable warning sign taken from paragraph 3.2 of Part II, or marked as provided in paragraph 1 of Part III, unless the labelling of individual packages or containers is adequate for this purpose. If there is no equivalent warning sign in paragraph 3.2 of Part II to warn about hazardous chemical substances or mixtures, the relevant hazard pictogram, as laid down in Annex V to the CLP Regulation, shall be used.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4/b" id="regulation-4-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part II, after paragraph 2.2 insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" Format="double"><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2.3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The “General danger” warning sign shall not be used to warn about hazardous substances or mixtures, except for cases where the warning sign is used to indicate stores of a number of hazardous substances or mixtures in accordance with paragraph 5 of Part III of Schedule 1 to these Regulations.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4/c" id="regulation-4-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 3.2 of Part II, delete the warning sign for ‘Harmful or irritant material’;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4/d" id="regulation-4-4-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part III—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4/d/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4/d/i" id="regulation-4-4-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for paragraph 1 substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" Format="double"><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Containers used at work for chemical substances or mixtures classified as hazardous according to the criteria for any physical or health hazard class in accordance with the CLP Regulation, and containers used for storage of such hazardous substances or mixtures, together with the visible pipes containing or transporting such hazardous substances or mixtures, shall be labelled with the relevant hazard pictograms in accordance with that Regulation.</Text>
</P1para>
<P1para>
<Text>Paragraph 1 does not apply to containers used at work for brief periods nor to containers whose contents change frequently, provided that alternative adequate measures are taken, in particular for information and/or training which guarantee the same level of protection.</Text>
</P1para>
<P1para>
<Text>The labels referred to in paragraph 1 may be:</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="dash">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>replaced by warning signs as provided for in Part II, using the same pictograms or symbols. If there is no equivalent warning sign in Schedule 1, Part II, the relevant hazard pictogram, as laid down in Annex V to the CLP Regulation shall be used.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>supplemented by additional information, such as the name and/or formula of the hazardous substance or mixture and details of the hazard.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>for the transporting of containers at the place of work, supplemented or replaced by signs applicable throughout the Union for the transport of hazardous substances or mixtures.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4/d/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/265/regulation/4/4/d/ii" id="regulation-4-4-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in paragraph 5, for “dangerous substances or preparations”, in both places where it occurs substitute “hazardous substances or mixtures”.</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

SCHEDULE 14 AMENDMENTS AND REVOCATIONS PART 1AMENDMENTSHealth and Safety (Fees) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2012431The Health and Safety (Fees) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2012 are amended as follows.2In regulation 9 (Fees payable in respect of offshore installations)—ain paragraph (2) after “2007 Regulations” insert “or the 2016 Regulations”.bfor paragraph (3) substitute—3In this regulation, regulation 11 and Schedule 7—“the 2007 Regulations” means the Offshore Installations (Safety Case) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2007 and “the 2016 Regulations” means the Offshore Installations (Offshore Safety Directive) (Safety Case etc) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2016;“installation”, “current safety case”, “safety case” and “owner”, in a case concerning the 2007 Regulations have the same meanings as in those Regulations or in a case concerning the 2016 Regulations, have the same meanings as in the 2016 Regulations;“operator”—in a case concerning the 2007 Regulations has the meaning—in the case of the dismantling of a fixed installation under regulation 11 of those Regulations, given in regulation 11(4) of those Regulations;in any other case, given in regulation 2(1) of those Regulations in relation to a production installation;in a case concerning the 2016 Regulations, has the meaning given in those Regulations; and“competent authority” has the meaning given in the 2016 Regulations.3In Schedule 7 (Fees payable in respect of offshore installations) after the final entry in the Table insert—
Assessing a design notification (sent to the competent authority pursuant to regulation 15(1) or 19(1) of the 2016 Regulations) for the purpose of deciding whether to raise matters relating to health and safety and raising such mattersThe operator or owner who sent the design notification to the competent authority pursuant to that provision
Assessing a relocation notification (sent to the competent authority pursuant to regulation 15(3) of the 2016 Regulations) for the purpose of deciding whether to raise matters relating to health and safety and raising such mattersThe operator who sent the relocation notification to the competent authority pursuant to that provision
Assessing a safety case or a revision to a current safety case (sent to the competent authority pursuant to any provision of the 2016 Regulations) for the purpose of deciding whether to accept that safety case or revision and accepting any such safety case or revisionThe operator or owner who sent the safety case or revision to the competent authority pursuant to that provision
Providing advice with respect to the preparation of a safety case or a revision to a current safety case which is proposed to be sent to the competent authority pursuant to any provision of the 2016 RegulationsThe operator or owner who has requested that advice
Assessing whether to grant an exemption pursuant to regulation 35 of the 2016 Regulations and granting any such exemptionThe operator or owner who has requested the exemption

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Ionising Radiations Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2017<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/> are amended as follows.</Text>

</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2018/17/schedule/4/paragraph/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2018/17/schedule/4/paragraph/1/2" id="schedule-4-paragraph-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1) (interpretation)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2018/17/schedule/4/paragraph/1/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2018/17/schedule/4/paragraph/1/2/a" id="schedule-4-paragraph-1-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “carers and comforters” substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“carers and comforters” means individuals knowingly and willingly incurring an exposure to ionising radiation by helping, other than as part of their occupation, in the support and comfort of individuals undergoing or having undergone a medical exposure (other than as a carer and comforter);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2020/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2020/4" NumberOfProvisions="86" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Schedules><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2020/4/schedule/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2020/4/schedule" NumberOfProvisions="83" id="schedule"><Number>SCHEDULE</Number><ScheduleBody><P1group><Title>Health and Safety (Consultation with Employees) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1996</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2020/4/schedule/paragraph/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2020/4/schedule/paragraph/10" id="schedule-paragraph-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After paragraph 3 insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" Format="double"><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">3A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this paragraph—</Text><P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>Day A is the day on which the worker concerned complies with the requirement in paragraph (1) of Article 20A of the Industrial Tribunals (Northern Ireland) Order 1996 (requirement to contact Labour Relations Agency before instituting proceedings) in relation to the matter in respect of which the proceedings are brought, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>Day B is the day on which the worker concerned receives or, if earlier, is treated as receiving (by virtue of regulations made under paragraph (11) of that Article) the certificate issued under paragraph (4) of that Article.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In working out when the three month time limit set by paragraph 3 expires the period beginning with the day after Day A and ending with Day B is not to be counted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>If the three month time limit set by paragraph 3 would (if not extended by this paragraph) expire during the period beginning with Day A and ending one month after Day B, the time limit expires instead at the end of that period.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The power conferred on the industrial tribunal by paragraph 3 to extend the three month time limit set by that paragraph is exercisable in relation to that time limit as extended by this paragraph.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Secondary></Legislation>

http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="E+W+S"><Primary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1972/28/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1972/28/body" NumberOfProvisions="11"><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1972/28/crossheading/amendments-of-factories-act-1961" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1972/28/crossheading/amendments-of-factories-act-1961" NumberOfProvisions="9" id="crossheading-amendments-of-factories-act-1961"><Title> Amendments of Factories Act 1961</Title><P1group><Title> Medical examinations of persons employed in factories. <CommentaryRef Ref="c822781"/></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1972/28/section/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1972/28/section/3" id="section-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P1para><Text>The Factories Act 1961 shall have effect as if the following section were inserted after section 10 thereof:—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P1group Layout="below"><Title/><P1><Pnumber PuncAfter="">10A</Pnumber><P1para><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>If an employment medical adviser is of opinion that ther ought, on grounds mentioned in subsection (2) below, to be a medical examination of a person or persons employed in a factory, he may serve on the occupier of the factory a written notice stating that he is of that opinion and requiring that the occupier shall permit a medical examination in accordance with this section of the person or persons in question, and the examination shall be permitted accordingly.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The grounds on which a medical examination of a person may be required by an employment medical adviser’s notice under subsection (1) above are that (in the adviser’s opinion) the persons health has been or is being injured, or it is possible that it has been, is being or will be injured, by reason of the nature of the work he is or has been called upon to do or may (to the adviser’s knowledge) be called upon to do ; and a notice under that subsection may be given with respect to one or more named persons or to persons of a class or description specified in the notice.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A notice under subsection (1) above shall name the place where the medical examination is to be conducted and, if it is a place other than the factory, the day on which and the time at which it is to be begun ; and—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>every person to whom the notice relates shall be informed, as soon as practicable after service thereof, of the contents thereof and of the fact that he is free to attend for the purpose of submitting to the examination ; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>if the notice states that the examination is to be conducted at the factory, suitable accomodation therat shall be provided for the conduct of the examination.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A medical examination conducted in pursuance of a notice under subsection (1) above shall be begun within seven days after the day on which the notice is served, and shall be conducted by, or in accordance with arrangements made by, an employment medical adviser, and take place at a reasonable time during working hours.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>An employment medical adviser may, by written notice served on the occupier of a factory, cancel a notice served on the occupier under subsection (1) above ; and a notice which relates to two or more named persons may be cancelled either in relation to them all or in relation to any one or more of them.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In this section “ medical examination” includes pathological, physiological and radiological tests and similar investigations.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></BlockAmendment></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock></Body></Primary></Legislation>

under that provision.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock></Body></Primary></Legislation>

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43" NumberOfProvisions="102" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2024-10-14"><Primary><Schedules RestrictStartDate="2021-07-16"><Title> SCHEDULES</Title><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3" NumberOfProvisions="9" id="schedule-3"><Number>SCHEDULE 3</Number><TitleBlock><Title> Amendments of Part I of the Health and Safety at Work <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation> Act 1974</Title></TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/1" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Section 6 (general duties of manufacturers etc. as regard articles and substances for use at work) shall be amended as follows.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/2" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For subsection (1)

					(general duties of designers, manufacturers, importers and suppliers of articles for use at work) there shall be substituted the following subsections—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>It shall be the duty of any person who designs, manufactures, imports or supplies any article for use at work or any article of fairground equipment—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to ensure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that the article is so designed and constructed that it will be safe and without risks to health at all times when it is being set, used, cleaned or maintained by a person at work;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to carry out or arrange for the carrying out of such testing and examination as may be necessary for the performance of the duty imposed on him by the preceding paragraph;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to take such steps as are necessary to secure that persons supplied by that person with the article are provided with adequate information about the use for which the article is designed or has been tested and about any conditions necessary to ensure that it will be safe and without risks to health at all such times as are mentioned in paragraph (a) above and when it is being dismantled or disposed of; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to take such steps as are necessary to secure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that persons so supplied are provided with all such revisions of information provided to them by virtue of the preceding paragraph as are necessary by reason of its becoming known that anything gives rise to a serious risk to health or safety.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>1A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>It shall be the duty of any person who designs, manufactures, imports or supplies any article of fairground equipment—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to ensure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that the article is so designed and constructed that it will be safe and without risks to health at all times when it is being used for or in connection with the entertainment of members of the public;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to carry out or arrange for the carrying out of such testing and examination as may be necessary for the performance of the duty imposed on him by the preceding paragraph;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to take such steps as are necessary to secure that persons supplied by that person with the article are provided with adequate information about the use for which the article is designed or has been tested and about any conditions necessary to ensure that it will be safe and without risks to health at all times when it is being used for or in connection with the entertainment of members of the public; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to take such steps as are necessary to secure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that persons so supplied are provided with all such revisions of information provided to them by virtue of the preceding paragraph as are necessary by reason of its becoming known that anything gives rise to a serious risk to health or safety.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/3" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (2)

					(duty of person who undertakes the design or manufacture of an article for use at work to carry out research), after the word 

						“work” there shall be inserted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                  

						“or of any article of fairground equipment
                ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/4" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (3)

					(duty of persons who erect or install articles for use at work)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/4/a" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-4-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>after the words 

								“persons at work” there shall be inserted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“or who erects or installs any article of fairground equipment
                    ”</InlineAmendment>; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/4/b" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-4-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the words from 

								“it is” onwards there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“the article is erected or installed makes it unsafe or a risk to health at any such time as is mentioned in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) or, as the case may be, in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) or (1A) above.
                    ”</InlineAmendment></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/5" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For subsection (4)

					(general duties of manufacturers, importers and suppliers of substances for use at work) there shall be substituted the following subsection—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>It shall be the duty of any person who manufactures, imports or supplies any substance—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to ensure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that the substance will be safe and without risks to health at all times when it is being used, handled, processed, stored or transported by a person at work or in premises to which section 4 above applies;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to carry out or arrange for the carrying out of such testing and examination as may be necessary for the performance of the duty imposed on him by the preceding paragraph;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to take such steps as are necessary to secure that persons supplied by that person with the substance are provided with adequate information about any risks to health or safety to which the inherent properties of the substance may give rise, about the results of any relevant tests which have been carried out on or in connection with the substance and about any conditions necessary to ensure that the substance will be safe and without risks to health at all such times as are mentioned in paragraph (a) above and when the substance is being disposed of; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to take such steps as are necessary to secure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that persons so supplied are provided with all such revisions of information provided to them by virtue of the preceding paragraph as are necessary by reason of its becoming known that anything gives rise to a serious risk to health or safety.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/6" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (5)

					(duty of person who undertakes the manufacture of a substance for use at work to carry out research)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/6/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/6/a" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-6-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the words 

								“substance for use at work” there shall be substituted the word <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“substance
                    ”</InlineAmendment>; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/6/b" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-6-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>at the end there shall be inserted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“at all such times as are mentioned in paragraph (a) of subsection (4) above
                    ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-7"><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (8)

					(relief from duties for persons relying on undertakings by others)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7/a" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-7-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the words 

								“for or to another” there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“for use at work or an article of fairground equipment and does so for or to another
                    ”</InlineAmendment>;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7/b" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-7-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the words 

								“when properly used” there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“at all such times as are mentioned in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) or, as the case may be, in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) or (1A) above
                    ”</InlineAmendment>; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/7/c" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-7-c"><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the words 

								“by subsection (1)(a) above” there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                      

								“by virtue of that paragraph
                    ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/8" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-8"><Pnumber>8</Pnumber><P2para><Text>After the said subsection (8) there shall be inserted the following subsection—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>8A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Nothing in subsection (7) or (8) above shall relieve any person who imports any article or substance from any duty in respect of anything which—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in the case of an article designed outside the United Kingdom, was done by and in the course of any trade, profession or other undertaking carried on by, or was within the control of, the person who designed the article; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in the case of an article or substance manufactured outside the United Kingdom, was done by and in the course of any trade, profession or other undertaking carried on by, or was within the control of, the person who manufactured the article or substance.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/9" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-9"><Pnumber>9</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (9)

					(definition of supplier in certain cases of supply under a hire-purchase agreement), for the words 

						“article for use at work or substance for use at work” there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                  

						“article or substance
                ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/10" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1987/43/schedule/3/paragraph/1/10" id="schedule-3-paragraph-1-10"><Pnumber>10</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For subsection (10)

					(meaning of 

						“properly used”) there shall be substituted the following subsection—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>10</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For the purposes of this section an absence of safety or a risk to health shall be disregarded in so far as the case in or in relation to which it would arise is shown to be one the occurrence of which could not reasonably be foreseen; and in determining whether any duty imposed by virtue of paragraph (a) of subsection (1), (1A) or (4) above has been performed regard shall be had to any relevant information or advice which has been provided to any person by the person by whom the article has been designed, manufactured, imported or supplied or, as the case may be, by the person by whom the substance has been manufactured, imported or supplied.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Primary></Legislation>
