<Text>alterations have not been made to the hull or superstructures which would affect the calculations determining the position of the load line;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the fittings and appliances for the protection of openings, guard rails, freeing ports and means of access to crew’s quarters are maintained in an effective condition;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the appropriate marks are correctly and permanently indicated; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>information is provided in accordance with regulations 32 and 33.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/10" id="regulation-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 8(3), before “the International” there shall be inserted “ the International Load Line Certificate,”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/11" id="regulation-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 9(1), for “the appropriate certificate” there shall be substituted “an International Load Line Certificate in the case of a Convention-size ship, or a United Kingdom Load Line Certificate in the case of any other ship,”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/12" id="regulation-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 9(2) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If the certificate is an International Load Line Certificate it shall be in the form prescribed by Annex <Acronym Expansion="3">III</Acronym> to the 1988 Protocol.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/13/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/13" id="regulation-13">
<Pnumber>13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 9(3), for “MSN 1701 (M)” there shall be substituted “ MSN 1752 (M)”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/14" id="regulation-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 9(5), for “to issue or authorise the issue” to the end of the paragraph there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to issue or authorise the issue of, in respect of the ship, an International Load Line Certificate, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of an annual survey required under regulation 8(1)(c), to endorse or authorise the endorsement of the International Load Line Certificate, the International Load Line Certificate (1966) or, as the case may be, the United Kingdom Load Line Certificate accordingly;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and a certificate issued or an endorsement made in accordance with such a request, and containing a statement that it has been so issued or made, shall have the same effect as if it had been issued by the Secretary of State or made by a surveyor respectively.</Text>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15" id="regulation-15">
<Pnumber>15</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 9(6)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/a" id="regulation-15-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>“(1966)” shall be omitted, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/15/b" id="regulation-15-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (a) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the ship has already been subjected to satisfactory initial, renewal and annual surveys, as appropriate;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/16/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/16" id="regulation-16">
<Pnumber>16</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 10 there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs (2), (4), (5) and (6), the duration of any certificate issued under these Regulations shall not exceed a period of five years beginning with the date of completion of the initial or renewal survey referred to in regulation 8(1)(a) or (b) respectively.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>When the renewal survey referred to in regulation 8(1)(b) is completed within three months before the expiry of the existing certificate, the new certificate shall be valid for a period beginning with the date of completion of the renewal survey and ending on a date which does not exceed five years from the expiry of the existing certificate.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>When the renewal survey referred to in regulation 8(1)(b) is completed after the expiry of the existing certificate, the new certificate shall be valid for a period beginning with the date of completion of the renewal survey and ending on a date which does not exceed five years from the expiry of the previous certificate.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>When the renewal survey referred to in regulation 8(1)(b) is completed more than three months before the expiry of the existing certificate, the new certificate shall be valid for a period beginning with the date of completion of the renewal survey and ending on a date which does not exceed five years from the date of completion of the renewal survey.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If a certificate is issued for a period of less than five years, the Assigning Authority may extend the validity of the certificate beyond the expiry date to the maximum period specified in paragraph (1), provided that the annual surveys applicable when a certificate is issued for a period of five years are carried out as appropriate.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If, after the renewal survey, a new certificate cannot be issued to the ship before the expiry of the existing certificate, the Assigning Authority may extend the validity of the existing certificate for a period which shall not exceed five months. This extension shall be endorsed on the certificate, and shall be granted only where there have been no alterations in the structure, equipment, arrangements, materials or scantlings which affect the ship’s freeboard.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If, at the time when a certificate expires, a ship is not in a port in which it is to be surveyed, the Assigning Authority may extend the validity of the certificate but this extension shall be granted only where it appears proper and reasonable to the Assigning Authority to do so for the purpose of allowing the ship to complete its voyage to the port in which it is to be surveyed. No certificate shall be extended for a period longer than three months beginning with the date of expiry, and a ship to which an extension is granted shall not, on its arrival in the port in which it is to be surveyed, be entitled by virtue of such extension to leave that port without having a new certificate. When the renewal survey is completed, the new certificate shall be valid for a period ending on a date which does not exceed five years from the expiry of the previous certificate before the extension was granted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A certificate issued to a ship engaged on short voyages which has not been extended under paragraph (3), (4) or (5) of this regulation may be extended by the Assigning Authority for a period of not more than one month beginning with the date of its expiry. When the renewal survey is completed the new certificate shall be valid for a period ending on a date which does not exceed five years from the expiry of the previous certificate before the extension was granted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In special circumstances, as determined by the Assigning Authority, a new certificate need not be dated from the expiry of the previous certificate before the extension was granted, as required by paragraphs (2), (5) and (6). In these special circumstances, the new certificate shall be valid for a period ending on a date which is not more than five years from the date of completion of the renewal survey.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If an annual survey is completed before the period specified in regulation 8(1)(c) then:</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a new anniversary date shall be endorsed on the certificate which shall not be more than three months later than the date on which the annual survey was completed;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the subsequent annual survey required by regulation 8(1)(c) shall be completed at the intervals prescribed by that regulation using the new anniversary date;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the expiry date of the certificate may remain unchanged provided one or more annual surveys are carried out so that the maximum intervals between the surveys prescribed by regulation 8(1)(c) are not exceeded.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/17/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/17" id="regulation-17">
<Pnumber>17</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 11 there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Certificates ceasing to be valid, and surrender and cancellation of certificates</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An appropriate certificate issued in respect of a United Kingdom ship shall cease to be valid where—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>material alterations have taken place in the hull or superstructures of the ship such as would necessitate the assignment of an increased freeboard;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the fittings and appliances mentioned in regulation 8(1)(c)(ii) are not maintained in an effective condition;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the certificate is not endorsed in accordance with regulation 8(3) to show the ship has been surveyed in accordance with regulation 8(1)(c);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the structural strength of the ship is lowered to such an extent that the ship is unsafe;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a new certificate is issued in respect of the ship; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the ship ceases to be a United Kingdom ship.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Secretary of State may cancel an appropriate certificate issued in respect of a United Kingdom ship if he is satisfied that—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the certificate was issued on false or erroneous information;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>information on the basis of which freeboards were assigned to the ship was incorrect in a material particular; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the ship ceases to comply with the conditions of assignment relating to it.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the Secretary of State proposes to cancel a certificate, he shall first notify the owner in writing, specifying the grounds for the proposed cancellation.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (5), the Secretary of State shall not cancel the certificate until the owner has been given a reasonable opportunity to make representations, and the Secretary of State has considered any such representations made.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph (4) shall not apply where the Secretary of State considers that urgent safety considerations so require.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Secretary of State may require any certificate issued under these Regulations which has expired, ceased to be valid, or been cancelled, to be surrendered as he directs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The requirement that the notification referred to in paragraph (3) should be in writing is satisfied where the text of the notification—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is transmitted by electronic means,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is received in legible form, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is capable of being used for subsequent reference.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/18/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/18" id="regulation-18">
<Pnumber>18</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 12(1) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a ship is exempted under regulation 5(1) or (3), an International Load Line Exemption Certificate in the form prescribed by the 1966 Convention as amended by Annex III to the 1988 Protocol shall be issued in respect of the ship by the Secretary of State.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/19/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/19" id="regulation-19">
<Pnumber>19</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 12(2)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/19/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/19/a" id="regulation-19-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the quotation marks around “United Kingdom Load Line Exemption Certificate ” shall be omitted; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/19/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/19/b" id="regulation-19-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end there shall be added—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>, and which shall be in the form prescribed in Schedule 8 of Merchant Shipping Notice MSN 1752 (M).</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/20/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/20" id="regulation-20">
<Pnumber>20</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 12(3), for paragraph (c) there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulations 8 to 11 shall apply in relation to the Exemption Certificate as they apply in relation to an appropriate certificate,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/21/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/21" id="regulation-21">
<Pnumber>21</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 13(2), for “MSN 1701 (M)” there shall be substituted “ MSN 1752 (M)”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/22/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/22" id="regulation-22">
<Pnumber>22</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 14(1)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/22/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/22/a" id="regulation-22-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after “1966 Convention” in both places it occurs, there shall be inserted “as amended by the 1988 Protocol”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/22/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/22/b" id="regulation-22-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>“(1966)” shall be omitted.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/23/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/23" id="regulation-23">
<Pnumber>23</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 15(1), before “on each side” there shall be inserted “ by the owner”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/24/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/24" id="regulation-24">
<Pnumber>24</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 15(2), before “in accordance with” there shall be inserted “ by the owner”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/25/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/25" id="regulation-25">
<Pnumber>25</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 19(1)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/25/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/25/a" id="regulation-25-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for “regulation 18(2)” there shall be substituted “regulation 18(1) ”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/25/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/25/b" id="regulation-25-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (d), for “forward” there shall be substituted “ abaft”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Merchant Shipping (Load Line) Regulations

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335" NumberOfProvisions="48" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/body" NumberOfProvisions="45" NumberFormat="default"><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Merchant Shipping (Load Line) Regulations 1998<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> shall be amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/a" id="regulation-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “the 1966 Convention” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="the Protocol of 1988 relating to the 1966 Convention (Cmnd. 4419)">1988 Protocol</Abbreviation>” means the Protocol of 1988 relating to the 1966 Convention<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/b" id="regulation-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “amidships” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“anniversary date” in relation to a certificate means the day and the month of each year which corresponds to the date of expiry of the certificate;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c" id="regulation-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “appropriate load lines”—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/i" id="regulation-3-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for ““appropriate load lines” means the load lines” there shall be substituted ““appropriate load line” means the load line”, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/c/ii" id="regulation-3-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>before “an International” there shall be inserted “an International Load Line Certificate or”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/d" id="regulation-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “appropriate certificate”, for “International Load Certificate 1966,” there shall be substituted “International Load Line Certificate or an International Load Line Certificate (1966),”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/e" id="regulation-3-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Category A, B, C or D waters”, for “<Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> M. 1504” there shall be substituted “<Acronym Expansion="Merchant Shipping Notice">MSN</Acronym> 1719 (M)”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/f" id="regulation-3-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the definition of “column stabilised” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/g" id="regulation-3-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of “Convention country” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“conditions of assignment” means the conditions relating to construction, arrangement and stability with which a ship must comply in order to be assigned freeboards;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/h" id="regulation-3-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Convention country”, for sub-paragraphs (a) and (b) there shall be substituted–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a country the Government of which is party to the 1966 Convention, or to the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a territory to which the 1966 Convention, or the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol, extends;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/i" id="regulation-3-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “exclusive surveyor” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Exemption Certificate” means an International Load Line Exemption Certificate or a United Kingdom Load Line Exemption Certificate;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j" id="regulation-3-j">
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “freeboard deck”—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/i" id="regulation-3-j-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (b) for “.” there shall be substituted “ ,”, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/j/ii" id="regulation-3-j-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for the paragraph beginning “When this lower deck is stepped” there shall be substituted, indented in line with the full-out part of the definition—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>a deck which is stepped being taken to consist for this purpose of the lowest line of the deck and the continuation of that line parallel to the upper part of the deck;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/k/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/k" id="regulation-3-k">
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “freeboard deck” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Certificate” means an International Load Line Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Certificate (1966)” means an International Load Line Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention before the relevant entry into force date (if any);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Exemption Certificate” means an International Load Line Exemption Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention as amended by the 1988 Protocol;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“International Load Line Exemption Certificate (1966)” means an International Load Line Exemption Certificate issued under the 1966 Convention before the relevant entry into force date (if any);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/l/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/l" id="regulation-3-l">
<Pnumber>l</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “length” and “(L)” there shall be substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“length” and “(L)” in relation to a ship means the greater of the following distances—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>96% of the total length on a waterline at 85% of the least moulded depth measured from the top of the keel, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the length from the fore-side of the stem to the axis of the rudder stock on that waterline.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Where the stem contour is concave above the waterline at 85% of the least moulded depth, both the forward terminal of the total length and the fore-side of the stem respectively shall be taken at the vertical projection to that waterline of the aftermost point of the stem contour (above that waterline). In ships designed with a rake of keel the waterline on which this length is measured shall be parallel to the designed waterline;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/m/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/m" id="regulation-3-m">
<Pnumber>m</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the definitions of “mobile offshore drilling unit” and “mobile offshore support unit” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/n/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/n" id="regulation-3-n">
<Pnumber>n</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “rake of keel” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant entry into force date” means the date when the 1988 Protocol enters into force in respect of the Government of the parent country of the ship in question;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/o/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/o" id="regulation-3-o">
<Pnumber>o</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “surveyor” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“United Kingdom Load Line Certificate” means a certificate issued under regulation 9(1) other than an International Load Line Certificate;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“United Kingdom Load Line Exemption Certificate” means a certificate issued under regulation 12(2);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/p/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/p" id="regulation-3-p">
<Pnumber>p</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “valid Convention certificate” there shall be substituted:</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“valid Convention certificate” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>an International Load Line Certificate (1966) or an International Load Line Exemption Certificate (1966), which is in force, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>an International Load Line Certificate or an International Load Line Exemption Certificate, which is in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>96% of the total length on a waterline at 85% of the least moulded depth measured from the top of the keel, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the length from the fore-side of the stem to the axis of the rudder stock on that waterline.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Where the stem contour is concave above the waterline at 85% of the least moulded depth, both the forward terminal of the total length and the fore-side of the stem respectively shall be taken at the vertical projection to that waterline of the aftermost point of the stem contour (above that waterline). In ships designed with a rake of keel the waterline on which this length is measured shall be parallel to the designed waterline;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/m/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/m" id="regulation-3-m">
<Pnumber>m</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the definitions of “mobile offshore drilling unit” and “mobile offshore support unit” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/n/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/n" id="regulation-3-n">
<Pnumber>n</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “rake of keel” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant entry into force date” means the date when the 1988 Protocol enters into force in respect of the Government of the parent country of the ship in question;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/o/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/o" id="regulation-3-o">
<Pnumber>o</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “surveyor” there shall be inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“United Kingdom Load Line Certificate” means a certificate issued under regulation 9(1) other than an International Load Line Certificate;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“United Kingdom Load Line Exemption Certificate” means a certificate issued under regulation 12(2);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/p/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1335/regulation/3/p" id="regulation-3-p">
<Pnumber>p</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “valid Convention certificate” there shall be substituted:</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“valid Convention certificate” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>an International Load Line Certificate (1966) or an International Load Line Exemption Certificate (1966), which is in force, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>an International Load Line Certificate or an International Load Line Exemption Certificate, which is in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/2174/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/2174" NumberOfProvisions="26" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/2174/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/2174/body" NumberOfProvisions="16" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations 1992</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/2174/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/2174/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations 1992<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> shall be amended—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/2174/regulation/6/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/2174/regulation/6/a" id="regulation-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 2(1), by inserting, before the definition of “new workplace”, the following definition—</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-disabled-person">disabled person</Term>” has the meaning given by section 1 of the Disability Discrimination Act 1995;</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha" Start="2">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in the definition of “workplace” in regulation 2(1), by deleting the words “but shall not” to the end of the definition;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by inserting after regulation 4 the following regulation—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Stability and solidity</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>4A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where a workplace is in a building, the building shall have a stability and solidity appropriate to the nature of the use of the workplace.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in regulation 5(3)—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="roman">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by deleting the word “and” after sub-paragraph (a);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem NumberOverride="ii">
<Para>
<Text>by adding the word “and” after sub-paragraph (b); and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem NumberOverride="iii">
<Para>
<Text>by adding the following sub-paragraph—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>equipment and devices intended to prevent or reduce hazards</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by deleting regulation 6(3);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in regulation 7, by inserting the following paragraph—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1)—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a workplace shall be adequately thermally insulated where it is necessary, having regard to the type of work carried out and the physical activity of the persons carrying out the work; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>excessive effects of sunlight on temperature shall be avoided.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in paragraph (2) of regulation 24, by adding the words “and the facilities are easily accessible, of sufficient capacity and provided with seating”;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in regulation 25, by substituting for paragraph (3) the following paragraph—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Rest rooms and rest areas shall—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>include suitable arrangements to protect non-smokers from discomfort caused by tobacco smoke; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>be equipped with—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>an adequate number of tables and adequate seating with backs for the number of persons at work likely to use them at any one time; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>seating which is adequate for the number of disabled persons at work and suitable for them.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by inserting after regulation 25 the following regulation—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Disabled persons</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>25A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where necessary, those parts of the workplace (including in particular doors, passageways, stairs, showers, washbasins, lavatories and workstations) used or occupied directly by disabled persons at work shall be organised to take account of such persons.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Merchant Shipping (Passenger Ships on Domestic Voyages) Regulations

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/1107/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/1107" NumberOfProvisions="3" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/1107/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/1107/body" NumberOfProvisions="3" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Merchant Shipping (Passenger Ships on Domestic Voyages) Regulations 2000</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/1107/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/1107/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For the definition of “the Directive” in regulation 2(1) (Interpretation) of the Merchant Shipping (Passenger Ships on Domestic Voyages) Regulations 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> there shall be substituted:</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the Directive” means Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1998/0018" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1998" Number="18">98/18/<Acronym Expansion="European Community">EC</Acronym></Citation> of 17th March 1998 on Safety Rules and Standards for Passenger Ships<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> as amended by</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Commission Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2002/0025" id="c00002" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2002" Number="25">2002/25/EC</Citation> of 5th March 2002 amending Council Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1998/0018" id="c00003" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1998" Number="18">98/18/EC</Citation> on safety rules and standards for passenger ships<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2002/0084" id="c00004" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2002" Number="84">2002/84/EC</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council of 5th November 2002 amending the Directives on maritime safety and the prevention of pollution from ships<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Commission Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2003/0075" id="c00005" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2003" Number="75">2003/75/EC</Citation> of 29th July 2003 amending Annex I to Council Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1998/0018" id="c00006" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1998" Number="18">98/18/EC</Citation> on safety rules and standards for passenger ships<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/></Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList><Text>in so far as the references in Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1998/0018" id="c00007" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1998" Number="18">98/18/EC</Citation> as so amended to the Conventions, Codes and System in their up-to-date versions:</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="roman">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>relate to all or any of the purposes set out in section 85(1) of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem NumberOverride="ii">
<Para>
<Text>are considered by the Secretary of State to be relevant from time to time, and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem NumberOverride="iii">
<Para>
<Text>are specified in a Merchant Shipping Notice.”.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Merchant Shipping (Passenger Ships on Domestic Voyages) Regulations

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883" NumberOfProvisions="6" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2022-12-19"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883/body" NumberOfProvisions="6" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2022-12-19"><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2004-11-29"><Title>Amendment of the Merchant Shipping (Passenger Ships on Domestic Voyages) Regulations 2000</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-09eba9"/>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1) (Interpretation) of the principal Regulations:</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/1/a" id="regulation-2-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (c) in the definition of “the Directive” there shall be inserted:</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<Text>and</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2003/0024" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2003" Number="24">2003/24/<Acronym Expansion="European Community">EC</Acronym></Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14th April 2003 amending Council Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1998/0018" id="c00002" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1998" Number="18">98/18/EC</Citation> on safety rules and standards for passenger ships<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>, and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/1/b" id="regulation-2-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “the Directive” there shall be inserted the following definition:</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2003/0025" id="c00003" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2003" Number="25">2003/25/EC</Citation>” means Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2003/0025" id="c00004" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2003" Number="25">2003/25/EC</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14th April 2003 on specific stability requirements for ro-ro passenger ships<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 3 of the principal Regulations, for paragraph (2) there shall be substituted:</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of the classification of vessels in accordance with the criteria set out in paragraph (1) above, the Secretary of State shall:</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>establish, and update when necessary, a list of sea areas under United Kingdom jurisdiction which includes the limits of zones for all year round operation and, where appropriate, for restricted periodical operation, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>publish that list in its updated version in a Merchant Shipping Notice and in a public database available on the Internet site of the Maritime and Coastguard Agency.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For regulation 6(1) of the principal Regulations, there shall be substituted:</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (1B) below, a ship to which these Regulations apply shall comply with the safety requirements specified in the Directive in relation to a ship of its class.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 6(1A) of the principal Regulations<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>, there shall be inserted:</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1B</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A ship of Class A or B the keel of which is laid or which is at a similar stage of construction before 1st October 2004:</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>need not comply with the safety requirements contained in Articles 6, 8 and 9 of Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2003/0025" id="c00005" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2003" Number="25">2003/25/EC</Citation>, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if it does not meet those requirements by 1st October 2010, must cease to operate as a passenger ship on 1st October 2015 or, if earlier, on the date on or after 1st October 2010 on which it reaches the age of 30 years.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/5" id="regulation-2-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 6(2) of the principal Regulations, there shall be inserted the following:</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In complying with paragraph (1) above a ship used for public transport:</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the keel of which was laid or which was at a similar stage of construction on or after 1st October 2004 shall, where practicable, be constructed and equipped, and display signs, based on the guidelines in Annex <Acronym Expansion="3">III</Acronym> to the Directive,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the keel of which was laid or which was at a similar stage of construction before 1st October 2004 shall, if undergoing modification, be constructed and equipped as respects that modification, and display signs as respects that modification, based on the guidelines in Annex III to the directive as far as is reasonable and practicable in economic terms.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/6" id="regulation-2-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 7 of the principal Regulations, there shall be inserted the following:</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Stability requirements for ro-ro passenger ships</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">7A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to regulation 7B(2), a ro-ro passenger ship of Class A or B, and a ro-ro passenger ship of Class C the keel of which is laid or which is at a similar stage of construction on or after 1st October 2004, shall carry a certificate, issued as respects a United Kingdom ship by the Secretary of State and as respects any other ship by the administration of the <Acronym Expansion="European Economic Area">EEA</Acronym> State or third country whose flag it flies, which:</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>confirms that the ship complies with Article 4 of and Annex I to Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2003/0025" id="c00006" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2003" Number="25">2003/25/EC</Citation>, taking into account in such compliance the guidelines set out in Annex <Acronym Expansion="2">II</Acronym> to Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2003/0025" id="c00007" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2003" Number="25">2003/25/EC</Citation> in so far as those guidelines are practicable and compatible with the design of that ship, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>indicates the highest value of significant wave height up to which the ship satisfies the requirements of Article 4 of and Annex I to Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2003/0025" id="c00008" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2003" Number="25">2003/25/EC</Citation>.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A ship to which paragraph (1) applies shall not operate in a sea area with a higher value of significant wave height than that shown on its certificate.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Seasonal and short-time period operation</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">7B</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the operator of a regular service which operates throughout the year wishes to introduce an additional ro-ro passenger ship to which regulation 7A applies onto that service for a period of less than one year, that operator shall give the Secretary of State at least one month’s notice of the proposed operation of the ship.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where:</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a ro-ro passenger ship to which regulation 7A applies is being introduced onto a regular service which operates throughout the year following unforeseen circumstances and in order to ensure continuity of service, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>that ship complies with the requirements of the Merchant Shipping (Mandatory Surveys for Ro-Ro Ferry and High Speed Passenger Craft) Regulations 2001<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>that ship need not comply with the requirements of regulation 7A, and notice of the proposed operation of that ship is not required in accordance with paragraph (1) above.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The operator of a regular service which operates seasonally for a period not exceeding six months in an annual period shall give the Secretary of State three month’s notice of the proposed operation of a ro-ro passenger ship to which regulation 7A applies on the service.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a regular service which operates seasonally for a period not exceeding six months in an annual period operates under conditions of lower significant wave height than those established for year round operation in Merchant Shipping Notice 1790, the significant wave height value applicable for this shorter time period may be used for determining the height of water on the deck of a ro-ro passenger ship to which regulation 7A applies when applying the stability requirements contained in Article 4 of and Annex I to Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2003/0025" id="c00009" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2003" Number="25">2003/25/EC</Citation>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/7" id="regulation-2-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 9 of the principal Regulations (penalties):</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/7/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/7/a" id="regulation-2-7-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1), after the words “these Regulations” there shall be inserted the words “other than regulation 7B”, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/7/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2883/regulation/2/7/b" id="regulation-2-7-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (1) there shall be inserted the following paragraph:</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any contravention of regulation 7B(1) or (3) of these Regulations by the operator of a regular service shall be an offence by that operator punishable on summary conviction by a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum, and on conviction on indictment by imprisonment for a term not exceeding two years, or a fine, or both.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>
