law.title: Merchant Shipping Act

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244" NumberOfProvisions="26" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/body" NumberOfProvisions="26" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendments to the Merchant Shipping Act 1995</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Chapter 3 of Part 6 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 (liability for oil pollution) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Meaning of “the Liability Convention”, “the Bunkers Convention” and other expressions</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 152 (meaning of “the Liability Convention” and related expressions) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, before ““the Liability Convention”“ there is inserted ““the Bunkers Convention”,“.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3" id="regulation-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (1) —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a" id="regulation-3-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of “the Liability Convention”, there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the Bunkers Convention” means the International Convention on Civil Liability for Bunker Oil Pollution Damage 2001;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention country” means a country in respect of which the Bunkers Convention is in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention State” means a State which is a party to the Bunkers Convention;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b" id="regulation-3-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Liability Convention State”, after “the” there is inserted “Liability”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4" id="regulation-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), after “Convention” (in the first place it appears), there is inserted “or the Bunkers Convention” and for “the Liability Convention” (in the second place it appears), there is substituted “that Convention”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Liability for oil pollution in case of tankers</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 153 (liability for oil pollution in case of tankers) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For “owner” and “owners” (in each place), there is substituted respectively “registered owner” and “registered owners”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/3" id="regulation-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), the words after paragraph (b) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/4" id="regulation-4-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After subsection (2), there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Chapter, such a threat is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/5" id="regulation-4-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subsections (7) and (8) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Liability for pollution by bunker oil</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After section 153, there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Liability for pollution by bunker oil</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">153A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to subsection (3), where, as a result of any occurrence, any bunker oil is discharged or escapes from a ship then (except as otherwise provided by this Chapter) the owner of the ship shall be liable—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused outside the ship in the territory of the United Kingdom by contamination resulting from the discharge or escape; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the cost of any measures reasonably taken after the discharge or escape for the purpose of preventing or minimising any damage so caused in the territory of the United Kingdom by contamination resulting from the discharge or escape; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused in the territory of the United Kingdom by any measures so taken.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to subsection (3), where, as a result of any occurrence, there arises a grave and imminent threat of damage being caused outside a ship by the contamination that might result if there were a discharge or escape of bunker oil from the ship then (except as otherwise provided by this Chapter) the owner of the ship shall be liable—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the cost of any measures reasonably taken for the purpose of preventing or minimising any such damage in the territory of the United Kingdom; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused outside the ship in the territory of the United Kingdom by any measures so taken.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>There shall be no liability under this section in relation to —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil from a ship to which section 153 applies, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2) arising in relation to a potential discharge or escape of bunker oil from such a ship,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>where that bunker oil is also persistent hydrocarbon mineral oil.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the subsequent provisions of this Chapter—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil from a ship, other than a discharge or escape of oil excluded by subsection (3), is referred to as a discharge or escape of bunker oil falling within subsection (1) of this section; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2), other than one excluded by subsection (3), is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a person incurs a liability under subsection (1) or (2) he shall also be liable for any damage or cost for which he would be liable under that subsection if the references in it to the territory of the United Kingdom included the territory of any other Bunkers Convention country.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>as a result of any occurrence, a liability is incurred under this section by the owner of each of two or more ships, but</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the damage or cost for which each of the owners would be liable cannot reasonably be separated from that for which the other or others would be liable,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>each of the owners shall be liable, jointly with the other or others, for the whole of the damage or cost for which the owners together would be liable under this section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Chapter (except in section 170(1)) “owner”, except when used in the term “registered owner”, means the registered owner, bareboat charterer, manager and operator of the ship.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Further liability for oil pollution</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/1" id="regulation-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 154 (liability for pollution in case of other ships) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/2" id="regulation-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, for “in case of other ships” there is substituted “in other cases”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/3" id="regulation-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For “owner” and “owners” (in each place), there is substituted respectively “registered owner” and “registered owners”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/4" id="regulation-6-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsections (1) and (2), at the beginning there is inserted “Subject to subsection (2A),” and the words “other than a ship to which section 153 applies” are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/5" id="regulation-6-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), the words after paragraph (b) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/6" id="regulation-6-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After subsection (2), there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>No liability shall be incurred under this section by reason of—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of oil from a ship to which section 153 applies or a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of that section;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil falling within section 153A(1) or a relevant threat of contamination falling within section 153A(2).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2B</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the subsequent provisions of this Chapter—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of oil from a ship, other than one excluded by subsection (2A), is referred to as a discharge or escape of oil falling within subsection (1) of this section; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2), other than one excluded by subsection (2A), is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/7" id="regulation-6-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (5), after “section”, there is inserted “(apart from subsection (2A))”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Exceptions from liability under sections 153, 153A and 154</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7" id="regulation-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/1" id="regulation-7-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 155 (exceptions from liability under sections 153 and 154) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/2" id="regulation-7-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, after “153”, there is inserted “, 153A”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/3" id="regulation-7-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the words from “No” to “contamination” (in the second place it appears) there is substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>No liability shall be incurred by a person (“the defendant”) under section 153, 153A or 154 by reason of a discharge or escape of oil or bunker oil from a ship, or of a relevant threat of contamination, if the defendant proves that subsection (2) applies.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This subsection applies if the discharge or escape or the relevant threat of contamination (as the case may be) —</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/7/4" id="regulation-7-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph (b), for “owner”, there is substituted “defendant”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Restriction of liability for oil pollution</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8" id="regulation-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/1" id="regulation-8-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 156 (restriction of liability for oil pollution) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/2" id="regulation-8-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, for “oil pollution”, there is substituted “pollution from oil or bunker oil”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/3" id="regulation-8-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (1)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/3/a" id="regulation-8-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraphs (a) and (b), there is substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>there is a discharge or escape of oil from a ship to which section 153 applies or there arises a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of that section, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>there is a discharge or escape of oil falling within section 154(1) or there arises a relevant threat of contamination falling within section 154(2),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/3/b" id="regulation-8-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for “owner”, there is substituted “registered owner”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/4" id="regulation-8-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), for “owner”, in both places, there is substituted “registered owner”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/5" id="regulation-8-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After subsection (2), there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where, as a result of any occurrence—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>there is a discharge or escape of bunker oil falling within section 153A(1), or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>there arises a relevant threat of contamination falling within section 153A(2),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>then, whether or not the owner of the ship in question incurs any liability under section 153A—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>he shall not be liable otherwise than under that section for any such damage or cost as is mentioned in it; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>no person to whom this paragraph applies shall be liable for any such damage or cost unless it resulted from anything done or omitted to be done by him either with intent to cause any such damage or cost or recklessly and in the knowledge that any such damage or cost would probably result.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2B</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subsection (2A)(ii) applies to—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any servant or agent of the owner;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any person not falling within paragraph (a) above but engaged in any capacity on board the ship or to perform any service for the ship;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any person performing salvage operations with the consent of the owner of the ship or on the instructions of a competent public authority;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any person taking any such measures as are mentioned in subsection (1)(b) or (2)(a) of section 153A;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any servant or agent of a person falling within paragraph (c) or (d).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/8/6" id="regulation-8-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (3), for “the owner of a ship under section 153 or 154”, there is substituted “a person under section 153, 153A or 154”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Liability under section 153, 153A or 154: supplementary provisions</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/9" id="regulation-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After section 156, there is inserted—-</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Liability under section 153, 153A or 154: supplementary provisions</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">156A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this Chapter —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>references to a discharge or escape of oil or bunker oil from a ship are references to such a discharge or escape wherever it may occur;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>references to a discharge or escape of oil from a ship include a discharge or escape of oil carried in the bunkers of the ship;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where more than one discharge or escape of oil or bunker oil results from the same occurrence or from a series of occurrences having the same origin, they shall be treated as one, but any measures taken after the first of them shall be deemed to have been taken after the discharge or escape; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where a relevant threat of contamination results from a series of occurrences having the same origin, they shall be treated as a single occurrence.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Law Reform (Contributory Negligence) Act 1945<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> and, in Northern Ireland, the Law Reform (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act (Northern Ireland) 1948<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> shall apply in relation to any damage or cost for which a person is liable under section 153, 153A or 154, but which is not due to his fault, as if it were due to his fault.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Limitation of liability under section 153</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/10" id="regulation-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the cross-heading before section 157, at the end, there is inserted “<Emphasis>under section 153</Emphasis>”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/11" id="regulation-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In section 157 (limitation of liability under section 153) —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/11/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/11/a" id="regulation-11-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (1), for “owner” there is substituted “registered owner” and after “contamination” there is inserted “falling within subsection (2) of that section”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/11/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/11/b" id="regulation-11-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (3), for “owner” there is substituted “registered owner”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Merchant Shipping Act

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244" NumberOfProvisions="26" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/body" NumberOfProvisions="26" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendments to the Merchant Shipping Act 1995</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Chapter 3 of Part 6 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 (liability for oil pollution) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Meaning of “the Liability Convention”, “the Bunkers Convention” and other expressions</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 152 (meaning of “the Liability Convention” and related expressions) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, before ““the Liability Convention”“ there is inserted ““the Bunkers Convention”,“.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3" id="regulation-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (1) —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a" id="regulation-3-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of “the Liability Convention”, there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the Bunkers Convention” means the International Convention on Civil Liability for Bunker Oil Pollution Damage 2001;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention country” means a country in respect of which the Bunkers Convention is in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention State” means a State which is a party to the Bunkers Convention;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b" id="regulation-3-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Liability Convention State”, after “the” there is inserted “Liability”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4" id="regulation-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), after “Convention” (in the first place it appears), there is inserted “or the Bunkers Convention” and for “the Liability Convention” (in the second place it appears), there is substituted “that Convention”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Merchant Shipping Act

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244" NumberOfProvisions="26" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/body" NumberOfProvisions="26" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendments to the Merchant Shipping Act 1995</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Chapter 3 of Part 6 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 (liability for oil pollution) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Meaning of “the Liability Convention”, “the Bunkers Convention” and other expressions</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 152 (meaning of “the Liability Convention” and related expressions) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, before ““the Liability Convention”“ there is inserted ““the Bunkers Convention”,“.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3" id="regulation-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (1) —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a" id="regulation-3-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of “the Liability Convention”, there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the Bunkers Convention” means the International Convention on Civil Liability for Bunker Oil Pollution Damage 2001;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention country” means a country in respect of which the Bunkers Convention is in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention State” means a State which is a party to the Bunkers Convention;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b" id="regulation-3-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Liability Convention State”, after “the” there is inserted “Liability”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4" id="regulation-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), after “Convention” (in the first place it appears), there is inserted “or the Bunkers Convention” and for “the Liability Convention” (in the second place it appears), there is substituted “that Convention”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Liability for oil pollution in case of tankers</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 153 (liability for oil pollution in case of tankers) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For “owner” and “owners” (in each place), there is substituted respectively “registered owner” and “registered owners”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/3" id="regulation-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), the words after paragraph (b) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/4" id="regulation-4-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After subsection (2), there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Chapter, such a threat is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/5" id="regulation-4-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subsections (7) and (8) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Liability for pollution by bunker oil</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After section 153, there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Liability for pollution by bunker oil</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">153A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to subsection (3), where, as a result of any occurrence, any bunker oil is discharged or escapes from a ship then (except as otherwise provided by this Chapter) the owner of the ship shall be liable—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused outside the ship in the territory of the United Kingdom by contamination resulting from the discharge or escape; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the cost of any measures reasonably taken after the discharge or escape for the purpose of preventing or minimising any damage so caused in the territory of the United Kingdom by contamination resulting from the discharge or escape; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused in the territory of the United Kingdom by any measures so taken.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to subsection (3), where, as a result of any occurrence, there arises a grave and imminent threat of damage being caused outside a ship by the contamination that might result if there were a discharge or escape of bunker oil from the ship then (except as otherwise provided by this Chapter) the owner of the ship shall be liable—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the cost of any measures reasonably taken for the purpose of preventing or minimising any such damage in the territory of the United Kingdom; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused outside the ship in the territory of the United Kingdom by any measures so taken.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>There shall be no liability under this section in relation to —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil from a ship to which section 153 applies, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2) arising in relation to a potential discharge or escape of bunker oil from such a ship,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>where that bunker oil is also persistent hydrocarbon mineral oil.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the subsequent provisions of this Chapter—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil from a ship, other than a discharge or escape of oil excluded by subsection (3), is referred to as a discharge or escape of bunker oil falling within subsection (1) of this section; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2), other than one excluded by subsection (3), is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a person incurs a liability under subsection (1) or (2) he shall also be liable for any damage or cost for which he would be liable under that subsection if the references in it to the territory of the United Kingdom included the territory of any other Bunkers Convention country.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>as a result of any occurrence, a liability is incurred under this section by the owner of each of two or more ships, but</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the damage or cost for which each of the owners would be liable cannot reasonably be separated from that for which the other or others would be liable,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>each of the owners shall be liable, jointly with the other or others, for the whole of the damage or cost for which the owners together would be liable under this section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Chapter (except in section 170(1)) “owner”, except when used in the term “registered owner”, means the registered owner, bareboat charterer, manager and operator of the ship.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Further liability for oil pollution</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/1" id="regulation-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 154 (liability for pollution in case of other ships) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/2" id="regulation-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, for “in case of other ships” there is substituted “in other cases”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/3" id="regulation-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For “owner” and “owners” (in each place), there is substituted respectively “registered owner” and “registered owners”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/4" id="regulation-6-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsections (1) and (2), at the beginning there is inserted “Subject to subsection (2A),” and the words “other than a ship to which section 153 applies” are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/5" id="regulation-6-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), the words after paragraph (b) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/6" id="regulation-6-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After subsection (2), there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>No liability shall be incurred under this section by reason of—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of oil from a ship to which section 153 applies or a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of that section;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil falling within section 153A(1) or a relevant threat of contamination falling within section 153A(2).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2B</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the subsequent provisions of this Chapter—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of oil from a ship, other than one excluded by subsection (2A), is referred to as a discharge or escape of oil falling within subsection (1) of this section; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2), other than one excluded by subsection (2A), is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/7" id="regulation-6-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (5), after “section”, there is inserted “(apart from subsection (2A))”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

SCHEDULE Schedule 5ZA to the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 Article 12

SCHEDULE 5ZA SUPPLEMENTARY FUND LIABILITY Article 4—paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 1 The Supplementary Fund shall pay compensation to any person suffering pollution damage if such person has been unable to obtain full and adequate compensation for an established claim for such damage under the terms of the 1992 Fund Convention, because the total damage exceeds, or there is a risk that it will exceed, the applicable limit of compensation laid down in article 4, paragraph 4, of the 1992 Fund Convention in respect of any one incident. 2 a The aggregate amount of compensation payable by the Supplementary Fund under this article shall in respect of any one incident be limited, so that the total sum of that amount together with the amount of compensation actually paid under the 1992 Liability Convention and the 1992 Fund Convention within the scope of application of this Protocol shall not exceed 750 million units of account. b The amount of 750 million units of account mentioned in paragraph 2(a) shall be converted into national currency on the basis of the value of that currency by reference to the Special Drawing Right on the date determined by the Assembly of the 1992 Fund for conversion of the maximum amount payable under the 1992 Liability and 1992 Fund Conventions. 3 Where the amount of established claims against the Supplementary Fund exceeds the aggregate amount of compensation payable under paragraph 2, the amount available shall be distributed in such a manner that the proportion between any established claim and the amount of compensation actually recovered by the claimant under this Protocol shall be the same for all claimants. Article 13—paragraph 1 1 Contracting States shall communicate to the Director of the Supplementary Fund information on oil receipts in accordance with article 15 of the 1992 Fund Convention provided, however, that communications made to the Director of the 1992 Fund under article 15, paragraph 2, of the 1992 Fund Convention shall be deemed to have been made also under this Protocol. Article 15—paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 1 If in a Contracting State there is no person meeting the conditions of article 10, that Contracting State shall for the purposes of this Protocol inform the Director of the Supplementary Fund thereof. 2 No compensation shall be paid by the Supplementary Fund for pollution damage in the territory, territorial sea or exclusive economic zone or area determined in accordance with article 3(a)(ii), of this Protocol, of a Contracting State in respect of a given incident or for preventive measures, wherever taken, to prevent or minimize such damage, until the obligations to communicate to the Director of the Supplementary Fund according to article 13, paragraph 1 and paragraph 1 of this article have been complied with in respect of that Contracting State for all years prior to the occurrence of that incident. The Assembly shall determine in the Internal Regulations the circumstances under which a Contracting State shall be considered as having failed to comply with its obligations. 3 Where compensation has been denied temporarily in accordance with paragraph 2, compensation shall be denied permanently in respect of that incident if the obligations to communicate to the Director of the Supplementary Fund under article 13, paragraph 1 and paragraph 1 of this article, have not been complied with within one year after the Director of the Supplementary Fund has notified the Contracting State of its failure to report. .

law.title: Health and Safety at Work etc. Act

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/960" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/960" NumberOfProvisions="61" RestrictStartDate="2018-01-01" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I."><Secondary><Schedules RestrictStartDate="2018-01-01" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I."><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/960/schedule/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/960/schedule/1" NumberOfProvisions="12" id="schedule-1" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2008-04-01"><Number><CommentaryRef Ref="key-800ca9"/>SCHEDULE 1</Number><TitleBlock>
<Title>THE SCHEDULE TO BE SUBSTITUTED FOR SCHEDULE 2 TO THE HEALTH AND SAFETY AT WORK ETC. ACT 1974</Title>
</TitleBlock><Reference>Article 20</Reference><ScheduleBody>
<BlockAmendment Context="schedule" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown">
<Schedule><Number>SCHEDULE 2</Number><TitleBlock>
<Title>Additional Provisions Relating to the Constitution etc. of the Health and Safety Executive</Title>
</TitleBlock><ScheduleBody>
<Pblock><Title>The Health and Safety Executive</Title><Reference>Section 10</Reference><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Executive shall consist of—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the Chair of the Executive, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>at least seven and no more than eleven other members (referred to in this Schedule as “members”).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<P2para><Text>The Secretary of State shall appoint the Chair of the Executive.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Secretary of State shall appoint the other members of the Executive according to sub-paragraph (3).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Secretary of State—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>shall appoint three members after consulting such organisations representing employers as he considers appropriate;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>shall appoint three members after consulting such organisations representing employees as he considers appropriate;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>shall appoint one member after consulting such organisations representing local authorities as he considers appropriate; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>may appoint up to four other members after consulting, as he considers appropriate—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the Scottish Ministers,</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the Welsh Ministers, or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>such organisations as he considers appropriate, including professional bodies, whose activities are concerned with matters relating to the general purposes of this Part.</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Service as the Chair or as another member of the Executive is not service in the civil service of the State.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Secretary of State, with the approval of the Chair, may appoint one of the other members appointed under sub-paragraph (2) to be the deputy chair of the Executive.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Pblock>
<Pblock><Title>Terms of Appointment of the Executive</Title><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs 4 and 5, a person shall hold and vacate office as the Chair or as another member according to the terms of the instrument appointing him to that office.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Chair or any other member of the Executive may at any time resign his office by giving notice in writing to the Secretary of State.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Secretary of State may remove a Chair or other member who—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>has been absent from meetings of the Executive for a period longer than six months without the permission of the Executive;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>has become bankrupt or has made an arrangement with his creditors;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in Scotland, has had his estate sequestrated or has made a trust deed for creditors or a composition contract;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>has become incapacitated by physical or mental illness; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>is otherwise, in the opinion of the Secretary of State, unable or unfit to carry out his functions.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Pblock>
<Pblock><Title>Remuneration of Members</Title><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<P2para><Text>The Executive shall pay to each member such remuneration and such travelling and other allowances as may be determined by the Secretary of State.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Executive shall pay to, or in respect of, any member, such sums by way of pension, superannuation allowances and gratuities as the Secretary of State may determine.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Where a person ceases to be a member otherwise than on the expiry of his term of office, and the Secretary of State determines that there are special circumstances which make it right that he should receive compensation, the Executive shall pay to him such amount by way of compensation as the Secretary of State may determine.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Pblock>
<Pblock><Title>Proceedings of the Executive</Title><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<P2para><Text>The Executive may regulate its own procedure.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The validity of any proceedings of the Executive shall not be affected by any vacancy among the members or by any defect in the appointment of a member.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Executive shall consult with the Secretary of State before making or revising its rules and procedures for dealing with conflicts of interest.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Executive shall from time to time publish a summary of its rules and procedures.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Pblock>
<Pblock><Title>Staff</Title><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<P2para><Text>The Executive shall, with the consent of the Secretary of State, appoint a person to act as Chief Executive on such terms and conditions as the Secretary of State may determine.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Executive shall appoint such other staff to the service of the Executive as it may determine, with the consent of the Secretary of State as to numbers of persons appointed and as to the terms and conditions of their service.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Executive shall pay to the Minister for the Civil Service at such times as that Minister may direct, such sums as the Minister may determine in respect of any increase attributable to this paragraph in the sums payable out of monies provided by Parliament under the Superannuation Act 1972.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>A person appointed to the staff of the Executive may not at the same time be a member of the Executive.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Service as a member of staff of the Executive is service in the civil service of the State.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Pblock>
<Pblock><Title>Performance of functions</Title><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<P2para><Text>Subject to sub-paragraphs (2) to (4), anything authorised or required to be done by the Executive (including exercising the powers under this paragraph) may be done by─</Text><P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>such members of the Executive or members of staff of the Executive as the Executive considers fit to authorise for that purpose, whether generally or specifically; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>any committee of the Executive which has been so authorised.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Sub-paragraph (1)(b) does not apply to a committee whose members include a person who is neither a member of the Executive nor a member of staff of the Executive.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Executive—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>shall authorise such of its members of staff as it considers fit to authorise for that purpose, to perform on its behalf those of its functions which consist of the enforcement of the relevant statutory provisions in any particular case; but</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>shall not authorise any member or committee of the Executive to make decisions concerning the enforcement of the relevant statutory provisions in any particular case.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Executive shall not authorise any person to legislate by subordinate instrument.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Executive shall publish any authorisations which it makes under this paragraph.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Pblock>
<Pblock><Title>Accounts and Reports</Title><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<P2para><Text>It shall be the duty of the Chief Executive─</Text><P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>to keep proper accounts and proper records in relation to the accounts;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>to prepare in respect of each accounting year a statement of accounts in such form as the Secretary of State may direct with the approval of the Treasury; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>to send copies of the statement to the Secretary of State and the Comptroller and Auditor General before the end of November next following the accounting year to which the statement relates.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Comptroller and the Auditor General shall examine, certify and report on each statement referred to in sub-paragraph (1)(c) and shall lay copies of each statement and his report before each House of Parliament.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>As soon as possible after the end of the accounting year, the Executive shall make to the Secretary of State a report on the performance of the Executive’s functions during the year.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Secretary of State shall lay the report referred to in sub-paragraph (3) before each House of Parliament.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this paragraph, “accounting year” means the period of 12 months ending with 31st March in any year; but the first accounting year of the Executive shall, if the Secretary of State so directs, be of such other period not exceeding 2 years as may be specified in the direction.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Pblock>
<Pblock><Title>Supplemental</Title><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Secretary of State shall not make any determination or give his consent under paragraph 6 or 8 of this Schedule except with the approval of the Minister for the Civil Service.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<P2para><Text>The fixing of the common seal of the Executive shall be authenticated by the signature of the Chair or some other person authorised by the Executive to act for that purpose.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>A document purporting to be duly executed under the seal of the Executive shall be received in evidence and shall be deemed to be so executed unless the contrary is proved.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This paragraph does not apply to Scotland.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Pblock>
</ScheduleBody></Schedule>
</BlockAmendment>
</ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Secondary></Legislation>

<Title>AMENDMENTS TO PART 1 OF SCHEDULE 2 TO THE SUPPLY OF MACHINERY (SAFETY) REGULATIONS 2008</Title>
</TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2157/schedule/paragraph/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2157/schedule/paragraph/1" id="schedule-paragraph-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For point 4 of the General Principles at the start of Annex I (Essential health and safety requirements relating to the design and construction of machinery) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" Format="double"><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Annex is organised in several parts. The first one is of general scope and applicable to all kinds of machinery. The other parts refer to certain kinds of more specific hazards. Nevertheless, it is essential to examine the whole of this Annex in order to be sure of meeting all the relevant essential requirements. When machinery is being designed, the requirements of the general part and the requirements of one or more of the other parts shall be taken into account, depending on the results of the risk assessment carried out in accordance with point 1 of these General Principles. Essential health and safety requirements for the protection of the environment are applicable only to the machinery referred to in section 2.4.</Text>
</P1para>

xmls: Amendment of the Merchant Shipping and Fishing Vessels (Health and Safety at Work) (Asbestos) Regulations 2010 2 1 The Merchant Shipping and Fishing Vessels (Health and Safety at Work) (Asbestos) Regulations 2010 are amended as follows. 2 In regulation 2 (interpretation), in the definition of asbestos, for “chrysotile, CAS No 12001-29-5” substitute “chrysotile, CAS No 12001-29-5 or CAS No 132207-32-0”. 3 In regulation 4 (application)— a in paragraph (8)(c)(i) after “activities” insert “in which only non-friable materials are handled”, and b in paragraph (8) (c) (ii) after “removal” delete “of” and insert “without deterioration of non-degraded”. 4 After regulation 29 insert— Review 30 1 The Secretary of State must from time to time— a carry out a review of these Regulations, b set out the conclusions of the review in a report; and c publish the report. 2 In carrying out the review the Secretary of State must have regard to how Council Directive 2009/148/EC , on the protection of workers from the risks of exposure to asbestos at work is implemented in other Member States. 3 The report must in particular— a set out the objectives intended to be achieved by the regulatory system established by those regulations; b assess the extent to which those objectives are achieved ; and c assess whether those objectives remain appropriate and, if so, the extent to which they could be achieved with a system that imposes less regulation. 4 The first report under this regulation must be published before the end of the period of five years expiring on 12th July 2018. 5 Reports under this regulation are afterwards to be published at intervals not exceeding five years. .

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2017/1149/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2017/1149" NumberOfProvisions="42" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2017/1149/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2017/1149/body" NumberOfProvisions="42"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Merchant Shipping (Working Time: Inland Waterways) Regulations 2003</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2017/1149/regulation/18/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2017/1149/regulation/18" id="regulation-18">
<Pnumber>18</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Omit regulation 14 (other special cases) and insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P1group>
<Title>Emergency situations</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">14A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>No provision of these regulations shall prevent the master from requiring a worker to perform any hours of work necessary—</Text><P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>for the immediate safety of—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the ship;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>persons on board; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>cargo; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>for the purpose of giving assistance to—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>other ships; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>persons in distress.</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In the circumstances described in paragraph (1), the master may require a worker to perform any hours of work necessary until the normal situation has been restored.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>As soon as practicable after the normal situation has been restored, the master shall ensure that any worker who has performed work in a scheduled rest period is provided with an adequate period of rest.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109" NumberOfProvisions="11" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/body" NumberOfProvisions="11"><P1group><Title>Amendments to the Merchant Shipping and Fishing Vessels (Health and Safety at Work) Regulations 1997</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7" id="regulation-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/1" id="regulation-7-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Merchant Shipping and Fishing Vessels (Health and Safety at Work) Regulations 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/> are amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2" id="regulation-7-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2(2) (interpretation)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/a" id="regulation-7-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “employer” insert—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“fishing vessel owner” means the owner of the fishing vessel or any other organisation or person such as the manager, agent or bareboat charterer, who has assumed the responsibility for the operation of the vessel from the owner and who, on assuming such responsibility, has agreed to take over the duties and responsibilities imposed on fishing vessel owners in accordance with the Work in Fishing Convention, regardless of whether any other organisation or person fulfils certain of the duties or responsibilities on behalf of the fishing vessel owner;”;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/b" id="regulation-7-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “seafarer” omit the words “which is not a fishing vessel”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/c" id="regulation-7-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “shipowner”, after the word “ship” where it first occurs in sub-paragraph (b) insert “other than a fishing vessel”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/2/d" id="regulation-7-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>after the definition of “worker” insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“Work in Fishing Convention” means the convention adopted at Geneva on 14th June 2007 by the International Labour Organisation<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/></Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3" id="regulation-7-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 3 (application)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/a" id="regulation-7-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (1A) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1B</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>As regards Group D and Group E ships—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the following provisions insofar as they apply to workers, also apply to seafarers who are not workers and insofar as they apply to employers, also apply to fishing vessel owners—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>regulation 4(1)(a),</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>regulation 5(1),</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>regulation 7,</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>regulation 12(1) and 12(2), and</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>regulation 20.</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in relation to seafarers who are not workers, any obligations imposed by the provisions mentioned in paragraph (a), to the extent that they would, by virtue of that paragraph, apply to employers and fishing vessel owners, apply to fishing vessel owners only.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/b" id="regulation-7-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2)(a) omit the words “with the exception of regulations 7(4A), 11A and 12A”,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/c" id="regulation-7-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2A) omit sub-paragraph (a),</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/1109/regulation/7/3/d" id="regulation-7-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3)(b) omit “only” and at the end insert “and Group D ships”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>
