PART 2Amendment of the REACH etc. (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019New Schedule 2A 6 After Schedule 2, insert— SCHEDULE2A Provision in respect of imports from Northern Ireland Regulation 4A 1 After Article 139, insert— Title 15A Imports from Northern Ireland Article 139A Protected NI imports 1 This Article applies in a case where there is a protected NI import of a substance. 2 There is a protected NI import of a substance if— a a substance— i has a relevant connection to Northern Ireland, and ii is imported on its own, in a mixture or in an article, b the substance, mixture or article is a qualifying Northern Ireland good, and c the person who supplies the substance, mixture or article for the import is a registrant or a downstream user under EU REACH as respects the substance as it is imported. 3 A substance has a relevant connection to Northern Ireland if— a it is— i manufactured in Northern Ireland, ii in a mixture that is manufactured or formulated in Northern Ireland, or iii in an article that is manufactured or produced in Northern Ireland, and b it is imported from a supplier established in Northern Ireland. 4 The importer of the substance (the “GB importer”) is to be treated for the purposes of this Regulation as a downstream user as respects any protected NI imports of the substance by them. 5 The provisions of this Regulation that apply to importers do not apply to the GB importer in relation to the protected NI import of the substance by the GB importer. 6 If the GB importer imports the substance in quantities of 1 to 10 tonnes per year they must, before they make a protected NI import— a notify the Agency of their intention to make the protected NI import, b supply the Agency with the information referred to in point (a)(i) of Article 10, c supply the Agency with the information referred to in points (a)(ii) and (iv) of Article 10 to the extent that information is available to the GB importer, d supply the Agency with the information referred to in points (a) to (d) of Article 32(1) and otherwise comply with Article 32, e supply the Agency with the relevant registration number for the substance under EU REACH to the extent that information is available to the GB importer, f supply the Agency with such other evidence as the Agency may require demonstrating that the information supplied in accordance with subparagraph (d) complies with the requirements of Articles 10, 12 and 14 (as they apply to the tonnage of the substance which the GB importer imports into Great Britain by protected NI imports). 7 If the GB importer imports the substance in quantities of 10 tonnes or more per year they must, before they make a protected NI import— a notify the Agency of their intention to make the protected NI import, b supply the Agency with the information referred to in point (a)(i) of Article 10, c supply the Agency with the information referred to in points (a)(ii) and (iv) of Article 10 to the extent that information is available to the GB importer, d supply the Agency with the information referred to in— i Article 14(6) to the extent that information is available to the GB importer, ii Article 31, and iii Article 32(1)(a) to (d), e otherwise comply with Articles 14(6), 31 and 32, f supply the Agency with the relevant registration number for the substance under EU REACH to the extent that information is available to the GB importer, g supply the Agency with such other evidence as the Agency may require demonstrating that the information supplied in accordance with subparagraph (d) complies with the requirements of Articles 10, 12 and 14 (as they apply to the tonnage of the substance which the GB importer imports into Great Britain by protected NI imports). 8 The GB importer must update the information provided to the Agency under paragraph 6 or 7 with any relevant new information and submit it to the Agency. 1 9. Paragraphs 6, 7 and 8 are subject to paragraph 6 of Article 139B. Article139B Notification by Northern Irish supplier where Article 139A applies 1 This Article applies in relation to a protected NI import of a substance. 2 A person established in Northern Ireland who manufactures a substance on its own, in mixtures or in articles, formulates a mixture or produces an article that is imported into Great Britain may fulfil the obligations on the GB importer under Article 139A (the “NI notifier”). 3 Article 36 applies to the NI notifier. 4 The NI notifier must, without prejudice to Article 36, keep available and up-to-date information on quantities imported and customers sold to, as well as information on the supply of the latest update of the safety data sheet referred to in Article 31. 5 A person who intends to act in accordance with paragraph 2 must inform the GB importer that they intend to do so. 6 If the GB importer is informed of the intention in accordance with paragraph 5, then paragraphs 6 to 8 of Article 139A apply to the NI notifier instead of the GB importer as respects any protected NI import from the NI notifier. Article 139C Authorisations and imports from Northern Ireland

Subject to Articles 139D and 139E, Title 7 applies to and in respect of substances imported from Northern Ireland as it applies to and in respect of other substances.

Article 139D Authorisations and qualifying Northern Ireland goods 1 This Article applies to a person (“P”) that is established in Northern Ireland that is a manufacturer, importer or downstream user of a substance under EU REACH. 2 P may apply for an authorisation in respect of that substance under Article 62 if the substance is a qualifying Northern Ireland good (“QNIG”). 3 A substance is a QNIG if it is a QNIG on its own, or contained in a mixture or article that is a QNIG. 4 This Regulation applies to P in respect of the application, and to the authorisation if it is granted, as if P was an only representative of P appointed in accordance with Article 8. Article 139E Application of Article 127G to qualifying Northern Ireland goods 1 This Article applies to a person established in Northern Ireland that made an existing application for an EU authorisation within the meaning of Article 127G(6) (the “existing NI applicant”) that satisfies the condition in paragraph 2. 2 The condition is that the substance in respect of which the application was made is a qualifying Northern Ireland good (“QNIG”). 3 The condition in paragraph (2) is satisfied if the application was in respect of a substance that is a QNIG on its own, or a substance contained in a mixture or article that is a QNIG. 4 Paragraphs 1 to 4 and 6 of Article 127G apply to the existing NI applicant as if the references to “Great Britain” were to “the United Kingdom”. 5 If the authorisation is granted— a it has no effect in Northern Ireland, b this Regulation applies to the existing NI applicant in respect of the authorisation as if the existing NI applicant was an only representative of the existing NI applicant appointed in accordance with Article 8. . .

<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Term>HSOSC</Term>” means a craft to which the Merchant Shipping (High Speed Offshore Service Craft) Regulations 2022 apply (see regulation 3 of those Regulations);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Term>HSOSC Code</Term>” means the Secretary of State’s Code for High Speed Offshore Service Craft (of less than 500GT carrying up to 60 persons), published on 9th February 2022, and includes any document amending or replacing it which is considered by the Secretary of State to be relevant from time to time and which is specified in a Merchant Shipping Notice<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Term>HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft</Term>” means the certificate of that name issued pursuant to regulation 13A;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/3" id="regulation-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 9, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P1group>
<Title>Surveys of HSOSC</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">9A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>An HSOSC is subject to the following surveys of its structure, safety equipment, radio installations and other equipment—</Text><P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>before the HSOSC is put in service or before the HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft is issued for the first time, an initial survey;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>at the intervals specified in the HSOSC Code, a renewal survey;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>within three months before or after each anniversary date of a HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft, a periodical survey; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>an additional survey as the occasion arises.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This regulation does not apply to an HSOSC which is not a United Kingdom ship but which is registered with a State with which the Secretary of State has entered into an administrative arrangement to accept certificates of a particular name or description which are equivalent to an HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/4" id="regulation-6-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 11—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/4/a" id="regulation-6-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the existing text becomes paragraph (1);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/4/b" id="regulation-6-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in that paragraph, at the end insert <InlineAmendment>“, subject to paragraph (2)”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/4/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/4/c" id="regulation-6-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (1), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>References in regulations 9A and 10 to surveys or inspections of a particular description which are required to be carried out on an HSOSC are to the surveys or inspections, as the case may be, of those descriptions as set out in the HSC Code, with any additions or exceptions as set out in the HSOSC Code.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/5" id="regulation-6-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 13, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P1group>
<Title>Issue of certificates to HSOSC</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>When an initial survey or a renewal survey to meet the requirements set out in these Regulations has been satisfactorily completed in respect of an HSOSC, the Certifying Authority must issue an HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This regulation does not apply to an HSOSC which is not a United Kingdom ship which is, or is to be, certified with a certificate of a particular name or description which is equivalent to an HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft and which is specified as such in a Merchant Shipping Notice.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6" id="regulation-6-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 15—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/a" id="regulation-6-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/a/i" id="regulation-6-6-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the words before sub-paragraph (a), after “Convention Certificate” insert <InlineAmendment>“or HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/a/ii" id="regulation-6-6-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (b), for “or Cargo Ship Safety Certificate” substitute <InlineAmendment>“, Cargo Ship Safety Certificate or HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/b" id="regulation-6-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2), in the words before sub-paragraph (a), after “Convention Certificate” insert <InlineAmendment>“or HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/c" id="regulation-6-6-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3), in the words before sub-paragraph (a), after “Convention Certificate” substitute <InlineAmendment>“or HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/d" id="regulation-6-6-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (4)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/d/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/d/i" id="regulation-6-6-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the words before sub-paragraph (a), for “to 9” substitute <InlineAmendment>“to 9A”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/d/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/d/ii" id="regulation-6-6-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (b), for “to 9” substitute <InlineAmendment>“to 9A”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/d/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/d/iii" id="regulation-6-6-d-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (c), for “to 9” substitute <InlineAmendment>“to 9A”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/e" id="regulation-6-6-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (6)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/e/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/e/i" id="regulation-6-6-e-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the words before sub-paragraph (a), after “Convention Certificate” insert <InlineAmendment>“, a HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/e/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/6/e/ii" id="regulation-6-6-e-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (b), for “to 9” substitute <InlineAmendment>“to 9A”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/7" id="regulation-6-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 16, in paragraph (1), after “regulation 13” insert <InlineAmendment>“, 13A”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8" id="regulation-6-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 17—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/a" id="regulation-6-8-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1), after “Safety Certificate” insert <InlineAmendment>“or HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/b" id="regulation-6-8-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/b/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/b/i" id="regulation-6-8-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for “to 9” substitute <InlineAmendment>“to 9A”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/b/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/b/ii" id="regulation-6-8-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after “Convention Certificate” insert <InlineAmendment>“or an HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/c" id="regulation-6-8-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/c/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/c/i" id="regulation-6-8-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for “to 9” substitute <InlineAmendment>“to 9A”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/c/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/c/ii" id="regulation-6-8-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after “Convention Certificate” insert <InlineAmendment>“or HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/d" id="regulation-6-8-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (4), after “Convention Certificate” insert <InlineAmendment>“or HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/8/e" id="regulation-6-8-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (5), after “Convention Certificate” insert <InlineAmendment>“or HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/9" id="regulation-6-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 22, after “Convention Certificate” insert <InlineAmendment>“, HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft or equivalent certificate described in regulation 23(5B)(b)”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/10" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/10" id="regulation-6-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 23, after paragraph (5) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>5A</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>No United Kingdom HSOSC may proceed to sea unless it has been surveyed and there is in force an HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5B</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>No HSOSC which is not a United Kingdom HSOSC may operate in United Kingdom waters unless it has been surveyed and there is in force—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>an HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a certificate of a particular name or description which is equivalent to an HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft and which is specified as such in a Merchant Shipping Notice.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/11" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/11" id="regulation-6-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 25 insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P1group>
<Title>Limit on the number of persons on HSOSC</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">25A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The owner and master of an HSOSC must ensure that there is not on board a greater number of persons than that stated on the ship’s HSC Code Safety Certificate for Offshore Service Craft or equivalent certificate described in regulation 23(5B)(b).</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/12" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/12" id="regulation-6-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 26—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/12/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/12/a" id="regulation-6-12-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1), for “to 9” substitute <InlineAmendment>“to 9A”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/12/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/12/b" id="regulation-6-12-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2), for “to (5)” substitute <InlineAmendment>“to (5B)”</InlineAmendment>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/12/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2022/41/regulation/6/12/c" id="regulation-6-12-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (5), after “regulation 25” insert <InlineAmendment>“or 25A”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/247/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/247" NumberOfProvisions="15" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/247/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/247/body" NumberOfProvisions="15"><P1group><Title>Other minor amendments</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2023/247/regulation/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2023/247/regulation/14" id="regulation-14">
